Tienen impacto en la comunidad tanto en la parte social como sustentable. Su vida y el mar se pinta de color rosa por la inspiración positiva que generan en la sociedad.

Este equipo no solo construye robots, promueve el STEM en su escuela y comunidad a través de diversos proyectos. Este equipo desarrolló profundamente todas las letras de STEM, desde llevar la imaginación de los niños al espacio hasta la participación en expo de ingenierías. Este equipo buscó generar cambios como en los puntos cardinales en 4 direcciones: for her, for all, for us, for them.

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: Tener un robot funcional y competitivo es un gran reto, pero combinar funcionalidad, robustez y estética es un reto mayor. Este equipo cuidó cada pequeño detalle como el diseño de sus propios engranes, tener un sistema neumático funcional y repetitivo, hasta avellanar cada barreno del robot. El orden en la electrónica, lubricación del intake en cada partida, tener piezas fabricadas con la mejor calidad habla de un gran compromiso del equipo con su robot. Por su alta dedicación en la fabricación, manufactura y cuidado detallado de su robot…

Un equipo que ha demostrado compromiso con la inclusión, haciendo parte de sus logros a personas que en su tiempo encuentran un propósito; innovan en la forma de impactar al medio ambiente y construyen su camino hasta este Regional a puro "cacahuatazo".

Este equipo, a pesar de todos los retos que enfrenta como equipo joven, demuestra más experiencia de la que uno pensaría. Este equipo consiguió duplicar el tamaño de su equipo en el último año, llevaron STEM a las comunidades cercanas que más lo requieren y ya se han convertido en un modelo a seguir, siendo inspiración de muchos. Sin duda alguna, a cualquier lado donde ellos van… ¡siempre buscan iluminar!

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: De la Sultana del Norte, teniendo al Cerro de la Silla como testigo, muestran una excelencia en organización, reclutamiento de nuevos miembros, conseguir apoyos y actividades de cuidado del medio ambiente. Por todo lo anterior y más…

Este equipo abraza la diversidad de sus integrantes, demuestra entusiasmo constante y consistente y ha superado diferentes desafíos con pasión. A pesar de coincidir solo una vez a la semana, tienen un espíritu inquebrantable que los ha hecho renacer como el fénix.

Equipo altamente consistente con el diseño y el desempeño de su robot en cancha, la rapidez y precisión es su principal fortaleza. Basan su estrategia en el pleno conocimiento de la competencia y enfocarse en obtener la mayor cantidad de puntos, como bien dicen: “victory beyond winning.”

Este equipo es un ejemplo de los core values de FIRST, su actitud positiva y de colaboración se nota dentro y fuera de la cancha, como su convicción de cooperar y apoyar a otros equipos, ¡fue evidente dentro de la competencia! Su espíritu de colaboración es extenso como los tentáculos de las medusas.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: Queremos hacer mención a un equipo que causó gran impresión por su adaptabilidad al momento de proponer, integrar, prototipar y construir su robot con el stock que tuvieron a su alcance. Las limitaciones de insumos no fueron un impedimento para ingeniarse una máquina funcional que los integró a la competencia. Por tanto, queremos otorgar este premio por su indiscutible creatividad a…

Los procesos de calidad no son fáciles de llevar, pero hacen una gran diferencia en el desempeño de un equipo y este llevó el seguimiento al desempeño del robot antes, durante y después de cada partida detalladamente, permitiendo que la toma de decisiones sea más efectiva para solucionar los problemas que se fueron presentando. Su portafolio y documentación de cada etapa de desarrollo, ideación e incluso manufactura de las piezas permitirá dejar un legado a las siguientes generaciones. Por llevar sus procesos de calidad a un nivel más allá de lo requerido…

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: Navegar en estas aguas exige más que resistencia; es ingenio, precisión y visión. Hoy reconocemos a un equipo que no solo enfrentó las olas, sino que las dominó con creatividad y control absoluto. Con sensores, motores y actuadores medidos, su creación escaló a lo más alto, dejando un legado que perdurará como faro en nuestros corazones. Con gran admiración …

Reconocemos al equipo que ha llevado la automatización al siguiente nivel, integrando sensores y actuadores con una interfaz gráfica innovadora. Su compromiso con la mejora continua se refleja en el uso de cada dato para perfeccionar su desempeño, demostrando la pasión y dedicación que impulsan la verdadera innovación.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: Queremos reconocer a un equipo que, en su corta trayectoria, refleja su identidad en cada elemento: desde su logotipo, colores, mascota, historia, robot y porra… ¡Un equipo que siempre apunta a escalar más alto!

Este grupo de piratas navegaron por varias islas, esparciendo riquezas y compartiendo conocimiento STEM con cada persona que se encontraban. Transformaron residuos PET en materiales para sus robots junto con otros equipos de la República. La comunidad que han creado ha roto fronteras y sus historias de impacto, que van desde su localidad hasta las playas y otros países del mundo, nos han inspirado para saber que cuando se comparte un ideal, se pueden sumar miles de personas haciendo una marea verde. Es por eso que, el ganador del Impact Award es equipo 3794, WinT

Es un equipo que promueve la comunicación en todas las formas posibles, incluyendo la lengua de señas mexicanas. Esperemos que los brotes de ciencia y tecnología que están sembrando florezcan en mayor inspiración hacia su comunidad, mientras ustedes ... ¡siguen volando en el desierto y más allá!

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: Su robot tiene un diseño multifuncional con una estructura muy limpia en la organización de sus componentes. Además de ello, presentan una estrategia de diseño que se puede ver reflejada en el desempeño del robot en la cancha, con una nostálgica esencia retro.

En medio de una historia de logros y aprendizaje, este equipo ha destacado por sus cualidades únicas en medio de capítulos de esfuerzo y coraje. Como lo dice su esencia mitológica, se eleva a través de los retos de cada partido, como el águila del sol que se pierde en el horizonte.

Por ser un equipo comprometido con su comunidad, a través de la difusión del STEM y los valores de FIRST, por tener una misión enfocada en el trabajo en equipo y el crecimiento constante a través de un sentido de unidad y comunidad, y por estar abriéndose camino en una flamante aventura.

Por no rendirse y mantener una historia de resiliencia y entrega en medio de situaciones complejas a través de un elevado espíritu de equipo; por encontrar formas de colaborar en contextos diversos, aún cuando las posibilidades fueran limitadas; y por ser embajadores de las causas de su entorno, mostrándonos cómo un robot puede transmitir un mensaje de paz más allá de la competencia.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: Este es un equipo multiinstitucional de la sultana del Norte que tiene un plan de negocios que ruge fuertemente y muestra la garra para reducir su impacto ambiental.

Este equipo nos transmitió su espíritu maya dentro y fuera de la cancha, mostrando un entusiasmo evidente que contagia a quienes interactúan con ellos… una familia rosa y aventada que avanza, reta y trasciende.

Este equipo cuenta con un robot completo que siempre da prioridad a las funciones del robot. Por filosofía buscan hacer todo y hacerlo bien. Además, logran hacerlo con un diseño limpio, compacto y bien pensado y, siendo fieles a su esencia, “they’re afraid of no bots!”

Porque FIRST es más que solo robots. Los jueces reconocen a este equipo porque en este año se destacó por su impulso a la ciencia y la tecnología, labor social y apoyo a otros equipos. Sobresale por lograr que sus integrantes primero aprendan y después enseñen, siempre empleando toda su energía, todo su voltaje.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: Su robot es una leyenda, con un diseño modular, intake versátil y electrónica elegante que demuestran la creatividad y consistencia en el campo.
Este equipo presenta un sistema de calidad robusto que incluye pruebas y diagramas de flujo para sus procesos, siempre buscando la mejora y facilitando el trabajo del driver.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: Este equipo buscó parametrizar sus diversos subsistemas con diferentes tipos de sensores y elementos para entender su entorno. Ellos no solo se enfocaron en funcionalidad, sino en implementar sus sistemas de control con enfoque en seguridad, calidad y automatización. Con la inspiración de aquel inventor de la mitología griega…

Este equipo buscó el perfeccionamiento de las acciones autónomas de robot para maximizar los puntos posibles en su partida, buscando el objetivo de más altura que los robots pueden alcanzar, y siempre manteniendo consistencia y precisión … ¡con un robot con sentido arácnido y rojo como ellos!

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: Este equipo tiene una imagen clara como el agua y demuestra consistencia en sus colores, robot y PIT, atreviéndose a ser … ¡siempre excepcionales!

Como capitanes de su propio destino, navegan entre islas acercando la filosofía STEM a los puertos de llegada. Se han aventurado en aguas desconocidas para demostrar, que no importa lo feroz de las olas, siempre habrá una mantaraya valiente lista para conquistar el horizonte. Felicitaciones, al equipo 6702 StingBots

Este es un equipo que ha demostrado un compromiso excepcional con la promoción STEAM, no solo en su entorno y sino más allá. No solo ha destacado en competencias, sino que ha extendido su pasión y conocimiento, inspirando la creación de nuevos equipos fuera del estado y fomentando una cultura de innovación y aprendizaje colaborativo. Desde su primer año, su labor ha trascendido las fronteras de su localidad, demostrando que la pasión por la ciencia y la tecnología puede ser un motor de cambio y desarrollo en diversas comunidades. Su capacidad para inspirar y guiar a otros, es un testimonio de su liderazgo y compromiso con la misión de FIRST. Por su dedicación a la expansión y promoción de las disciplinas STEAM, y por ser un faro de inspiración para otros equipos Felicitaciones, Equipo 6832 STEAMex

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: Hoy honramos al diseño que combina de manera excepcional la elegancia con una funcionalidad práctica, logrando la perfecta armonía entre belleza y eficiencia. Como la araña que teje su red con precisión, este robot cumple su función con maestría, destacándose como un referente de innovación. Felicitaciones al Equipo 4403 Roult PrepaTec Peñoles

Este equipo ha demostrado un crecimiento excepcional, duplicando su tamaño y fortaleciendo su impacto en la comunidad. A pesar de las complejidades geográficas de su región, que implican recorrer largas distancias para acceder a recursos educativos, han mostrado una resiliencia admirable. Mantienen el interés de la comunidad por la construcción y desarrollo de su robot que es un testimonio de su espíritu colaborativo y determinación. El deseo de perseverancia y superación está en su lema "Abre tus alas y descubre tus plumas de colores". Muchas felicitaciones para el equipo 9499 Kánari Tech - Fresnillo PLC.

Este es un equipo que, en su primer año de participación, ha demostrado compromiso con la misión de FIRST y un espíritu de colaboración ejemplar. Su dedicación a las ciencia, tecnología, ingeniería, artes y matemáticas (STEAM) ha sido evidente desde su fundación, inspirando a su comunidad y sentando las bases para un futuro prometedor. Su capacidad para superar los desafíos iniciales y entusiasmo contagioso los convierten en un modelo a seguir para otros equipos novatos. Felicitaciones al equipo 10562 STEAMex Scorpions

Este equipo no solo ha superado grandes desafíos como la pérdida de sus entrenadores, demostrado una resiliencia y determinaciones excepcionales, sino que se convirtió en un modelo a seguir para otros equipos jóvenes, destacándose como una promesa en el ámbito de la robótica. La capacidad para unirse, adaptarse y perseverar en circunstancias difíciles refleja los valores fundamentales de FIRST y sirve de inspiración para todos nosotros. Por su espíritu indomable pasión y compromiso... Felicidades al equipo 9120 SilverBots Fresnillo PLC

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: ¡Hoy celebramos a los héroes de la sustentabilidad! Quienes con más de 40 corazones comprometidos y más de un ciento de actividades, han demostrado que las prácticas sostenibles no son solo un sueño, sino una realidad. Sus logros a largo plazo y un ejemplo para todos, han germinado como una semilla de sustentabilidad. Ellos tienen un lema que es útil para todos nosotros: “se vale llorar, pero nunca rendirse”. ¡Muchas felicitaciones al equipo 5705 Desert Eagles - John Deere!

¡Este premio no es solo para reconocer habilidades, sino para honrar el alma de un equipo! Estos guerreros han demostrado coraje, pasión y una disciplina inquebrantable. Con su actitud impecable, originalidad y profundidad, han inspirado a todos a su alrededor. Su entusiasmo y motivación son contagiosos, y su espíritu unificado es un faro de rectitud, honor y lealtad. Hoy celebramos su fuego interior, su compromiso y su grandeza. Recibe el premio “Team Spirit Award” el equipo 4335 Samurái Code Peñoles

Hoy celebramos a un equipo que ha demostrado una comprensión clara del proceso de diseño, trazando cada elemento: desde la concepción hasta su implementación. No solo han desarrollado una solución práctica y funcional para el desafío Reefscape, sino que lo ha hecho con enfoque meticuloso y ejecución impecable. Con su determinación y pasión, han demostrado que la ingeniería no es solo una ciencia, sino también una forma de arte y legado. Y hay algo más que los distingue: en cada línea de código, en cada pieza ensamblada y en cada decisión de ingeniería, han honrado sus raíces, rindiendo tributo a las poderosas deidades aztecas. Muchas felicitaciones al equipo 4775 Aztech Robotics

Su nivel de compromiso con los Valores FIRST es muy fuerte, así como el trabajo con otros equipos. Tiene un impacto positivo en su comunidad, lo que han logrado a través de diferentes actividades en conjunto con el Club Rotario. Sus principales características son valor, confianza y equipo consolidado. Felicitaciones al Equipo 6200 PrepaTec X Rams.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: Este reconocimiento es para un equipo que ha mostrado su capacidad única para pensar fuera de lo convencional, para abordar desafíos con ideas transformadoras y para convertir lo imaginado en realidad, desde el estado más grande de México. Su espíritu creativo no solo destaca, sino que inspira a todos nosotros a mirar más allá de los límites y a encontrar nuevas formas de superar expectativas. Este carnero robotizado es un reflejo del impacto que tienen cuando combinan talento, visión y trabajo en equipo. Felicitaciones al Equipo 9301 MechRams PrepaTec Chihuahua

Este premio reconoce la fuerza y robustes de animal, es un testimonio de su esfuerzo incansable y de lo que se puede lograr cuando se trabaja juntos con pasión y determinación. Nos inspiran a todos a seguir apuntando y nunca dejar de esforzarnos por la calidad en todo lo que hacemos. Por eso su dedicación, compromiso y búsqueda constante de la excelencia los ha llevado a alcanzar este logro tan merecido. Felicitaciones al Equipo 9593 Rhinos

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: Así como los gatos destacan por su equilibrio, rapidez de reacción y estabilidad, este equipo ha demostrado una renovación excepcional en el control. Con el uso innovador de un iPad y sus funciones automáticas programadas, alcanzaron una alta eficiencia en cada partido. Por su brillante desempeño y enfoque vanguardista recibe el premio “Innovation in Control Award” el equipo 5526 Type C Peñoles

Durante más de una década, este equipo ha demostrado el significado de la constancia y la mejora continua, perfeccionando la autonomía de sus robots hasta llegar a un desempeño de 5 estrellas en el ranking del modo autónomo. Sin duda, este equipo sabe que el éxito no es solo el resultado de la tecnología, sino también de la perseverancia y una búsqueda inquebrantable por superar los propios límites. Ellos nos enseñan que imaginar es solo el primer paso para empezar a construir el futuro. Felicitaciones al Equipo 4400 Cerbotics Peñoles

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: Es un equipo lleno de energía, motivación y deseos de trascender que hace un gran esfuerzo y horas de camino para llegar a su lugar de prácticas de robótica. Su imagen demuestra el orgullo de todo lo que es su región y tierra de origen. Buscan cada año tener un gran impacto al hacer cambios y mejoras de su robots. Persiguen sus sueños para que la experiencia sea de un impacto positivo para el futuro de cada uno de sus integrantes. Felicitaciones al Equipo 7653 Minebots Fresnillo PLC -CECyTE 18 Ciénega.

This team is legendary, like Big Foot or the Loch Ness monster … And like the legendary beasts, they seem to be everywhere at once, spreading the FIRST and STEAM story, collaborating with the City, advocating for robotics appreciation, extending robotics to community centers, mentoring FLL teams, and much, much, more. This team ensures FIRST and STEAM cover the land.

Their robot’s colors are part of their message. Their passion for inspiring others around the world to engage in engineering has sent them flying. Given the gravity of this award, they are a force of inspiration to aspiring engineers.

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: The intellect of this team is the basis of their overall outstanding performance. This free-spinning team integrates all components designed by each of their many subteams. You really have to hand it to them, they can move in 360 degrees of brainy robotics engineering.
This team may have gotten off to a late start. They have broken into FIRST by overcoming a lot of difficult last-minute challenges. They have finally been able to break into the competition circuit.

This rookie team charged into the event, ready to compete with the veterans. They demonstrated fine teamwork in their gallop toward success. This team showed unbridled promise as they race for the horizon.
Rising from the cold, this team tumbled back into competition. They worked together with confidence like ice in their veins. Their future clearly has them moving forward and powering out in front.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team has hatched a plan to sustain not only themselves, but their community too. They grow by inspiring a new group of “Innovate-hers”. With an innovative approach to recruitment, they ensure team continuity.

When your enthusiasm is infectious and positive vibes abound, geographic isolation takes a back seat… and grassroots community building and advocacy is in the driver’s seat. This team spurred the creation of 6 county-based FTC teams! We celebrate their incredible energy, resourcefulness and collaborative team spirit.

This team may be extremely close to home. But this year, they had a very long rode to get here. They history of rebirth, renewal and invigoration helped them in creating an engineering notebook full of solid processes, engineering design sketches, and limited staking calculations. Their rookie programming team even ensured that their code had no bugs.
This team can be counted on to lend a hand… or three. They even kicked off the season with a mysterious gathering of local teams.It’s not that strange that they always step up to help.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: Some people might underestimate mountain builders, but their climber design altered our perceptions. They showed off their huge brain in their creative solution to this engineering challenge.
When others fumble, this team is the alpha, squarely funneling pieces into position.They polished the smallest details into perfection. Their robot is fit to take ET home.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: This team established a great connection between strong processes and the team’s results. Despite their simple-looking controller, their bot was on fire, smoothly navigating the autonomous period and dominating the field of play. If you don’t recognize their control excellence, you couldn’t see Forest City for the trees.

When their robot had to go solo, the team found power in the right combinations. They harnessed special electrons to create an atomic force that drove their robot forward. They showed a unique bond with autonomous operation.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team dug up their creativity in their choice of theme and image. Their robot, clearly no fossil, ensued, they made a visual impact. This team has truly surfed the wave in their quest for competition.

This team has levelled up the power of FIRST as a tool for advocacy, accessibility and outreach, leading positively charged change in their community. Though quirky, their work has made them an inspiring choice.

Getting involved with this team is always an adventure where all superstars are welcome! They are absolutely DINO-MITE and everyone TOAD's the line growing their teams in EGG's-ellance. This is the powered-up team who levels it up for everyone- Yoshi-licious!

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This team soars above the rest. Their iterative design process allows them to swiftly complete their robot. Their flying Phyto is the result.

This team makes quick work of elegant simplicity. LED's light the way to a confirmed win. They eat, breath and sleep robots making snappy work of coral placement at the flash of light. This well-rounded team SIMULATES an example for others.
This team started their FIRST season by fling high. Their foundation began in the offseason with a borrowed Bot. Now they are taking off with their own wings.

Despite their small size, this team shows strong teamwork and determination. They have risen above significant challenges. The team is resourceful and energetic, like their mascot, Steve, on a midnight snack run.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: When a storm "indiscriminately consumed their town", they had a sustainability plans in place to CHOMP their way out of the storm. This team was ready for any hitch!

In the stands or in their pit, this team shows high energy for the task at hand. Their cheers and wildly waving pompoms inspire their teammates. Despite their prickly appearance, this team has great team spirit.
When a direction for a design was needed, this team kept their base low while reaching high. They are a notch above in engineering.

This team's 3-D printer has made them a HOT commodity in the pits, including printing parts for other teams. Whether it is their enthusiasm, their support for other teams, or their cheering on alliances, this team is always more sweet than spicy. If you are looking for Gracious Professionals, just find the pink tu-tu's.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team thinks mechanically. They handle the task from any angle. Creativity excels in their Coral Corraller.

When previous "bots" did not perform as intended, a solid engineering design step was added to solve the problem. The result was to skip the fanciness and go back to the basic element. This fabricated a clean, solid, robust design that worked well.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: When others may get lost, this team finds the target. They use lasers and tags to lead to a score. This team is no stranger to innovation.

While working well with their numbers, this team was able to consistently automate their robot in succession. Their robot is able to score in both coral and algae. This team's Nautilus is being driven by Nemo.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team has so many plusses beyond their mathematically perfect branding. Decked out in orange, their robot plus sensory kits plus design notebooks all equal their geometric fox logo.

From the top of the mountain this team RISES for all to hear, They spread the word of FIRST, with a roar and a cheer. Yet it's no MYTH that they impact their community...not because they CAN, because they WILL.

Technology provides the spark lighting a flame so bright. Outreach spreads the STEM message of a brighter future. Leadership roots run deep, intertwined, the foundation for change and bright tomorrows!
This team's on fire, and ready to grow, They inspire their community with a neon glow Their Carolina Reapers are the best in show.

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: These daring visionaries were thoughtful in transforming concepts into realities. Though it took hours, the result was a pink bow used to capture the elusive coral. Like the Blackbird, we expect this team to soar to great heights.

This team is like the perfect chemical reaction. With their curriculum, they’re sparking little minds to learn and advocate for a better world. This team mixes STEM fun, curiosity, and action to create an explosion of knowledge!

records.awardName: District Championship Rookie All Star Award
records.script: The BONDS of this crew are built throughout, It is no SECRET that our judges were impressed. The SPECIAL INTELLIGENCE reveals that they are worthy agents of FIRST.

records.awardName: District Championship Rookie All Star Award
records.script: In the shadows they set the pace, while robots hum in a future space, This team is on the prowl, through the night, finding new team members for a future so bright !

They’re gaining momentum, unstoppable and strong, Overcoming every challenge, they’ve been pushing all along. With every move they make, they rise above the rest, Now they’re lifting others up, helping them be their best!

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team leveled up the community with their green power with SWOT (pronouced swat) analysis created a plan to power up the team year by year When things go wrong, they don't freeze, instead they glide through the maze, pixel-perfect

When things get thick in the jungle, this team cuts each other some Slack. They pride themselves on being not just a team but a family. This powerful team "weee - ha’s" their way into GRRRREATTTT team spirit!!

This team connected the dots between mechanical and electrical excellence. Using vision and odometry they automated control enough to make it simple, but still dominating on the field. Showing LEDs can communicate with a 2yr old from the Foothills

They string together the FIRST community with Gracious Professionalism. By posting their CAD models available for other teams to use, and hosting several FIRST events. This chilled energized team is always ready to serve and help.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: Like a F-22, this multi-role marvel creatively blends form, function, and finesse. Armed with coral and algae, one claw grips innovation, the other clutches collaboration. Flying solo or with their alliance, this long armed Dino rules the coastal plain.

This team chose not to hang around. But, their quality is a net asset and they quickly bounce into action. They may not change their stripes, but follow the changing lights to know that everything is awesome.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: Wherever it goes, this robot leaves a gushing swirl in its Wake. Push this team's buttons and their spout will erupt with innovative scoring. This blue leviathan will deliver a big score with precise control.

Known for their nocturnal tendencies, this team can independently find and score game pieces. They used their effective claw-like intake to dig deeper than their predators for reliable scoring. These spiny mammals came out of hibernation to deliver above-ground AUTONOMOUS performance!

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team shines with colours so bright it burst with sweet delight. They tie their school colours and their motto of "service, leadership in community and excellent" into their machine. This team doesn't fade into the background. They are loud, bright, fun and robust.
Rural communities are grateful for this pre-historic team, Their tail balances their commitment to expand STEM, They have taken a large bite to inspire our future with their impact.

This team's shirts really shout their enthusiasm for FIRST and their community. Their community demos showcase their love of robots and the environment. This team rides the STEM wave toward their communities pristine shore!

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: In a world of constant evolution, this team challenged the past. From fossils to form, this team pushed ancient boundaries to shape the future. They are modern architects of industrial design!

Despite the hurdles, they have sharpened their claws, With climber design that is clever and bold, they have reused their parts old and new, Through trials and tests, the Jaguars have stayed on track and will continue climbing!

They may share their name with a sharp jab, but this rookie team stung the competition. They tackled design challenges head-on, rallied support from other teams, and turned obstacles into opportunities. Driven by determination and powered by collaboration, this team is proving that rookie doesn't mean rookie-level.
This team has walked the tightrope of balancing schoolwork and robotics. Continuously overcoming obstacles, they are poised to set sail. In the coming years, this team is expected to truly shine!

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: When the future called for a greener path, this team answered. They powered their program with sustainable innovation. The team sustainability award surges to Team 5160.

Late nights and long hours didn't wear them down - they brought them closer. With non-stop energy and respect for every team, they turned their workspace into a second home and competition into a celebration. They are fierce, they are focused, they are the Titanium Tigers - Team 4829.
This team really soars above the crowd. Using precise waypoints to create a great plan, they stick the landing every time. They show that a pink bow can really make a robot professional.

They have mastered the art of lending a hand, whether its torque screws, code, or team morale. This team consistently leaps into action, solving hardward hiccups, sharing programming expertise, and supporting rookies and rivals. You might spot them by their cosmic theme, but you'll remember them for their mission - to embody Gracious Professionalism!

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This local team dove right into this year's challenge. In the heat of the moment, they did not let themselves sink. There fins allow them to stay slow and steady to win the race!
When the call came in to fly, this team spread their wings, They carefully built their nest, learning to mimic nature, They soared their way to Quality!

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: This cuddly team used their talents. They torqued a unique solution with their arm. And this provided a playful game unlike others!

Aligning their robot expertly and delivering the corral to the reef consistently, they rose to the top of the field. Their autonomous mode can even be adjusted for the current alliance. This team is receiving this award for implementing a novel, adaptable autonomous solution.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team embodies the spirit of adventure. They raise their team colors high in the sky. As they create a treasure chest of imagery!

This team is hot and full of burning desire to impact their community. Through their rings of impact with the team at the core, they demonstrated how they have expanded their flame by mentoring and supporting several FRC, FTC, and FLL teams. Through 60 events and over 9,000 volunteer hours, they supported people and students within their community. For example, they partnered with the School of the Blind and senior centers. Their impact went beyond borders when they mentored a team from Guinea - Bissau to help them compete at FIRST Global. This team has proven they have an eternal flame!

This team aligned on growing STEM in their community. Stopping people in their tracks as they window shop, this team welcomed hundreds of walk-ins, exchange students, and loves a "series" of parades. Similar to a "Fibonacci" sequence, we anticipate this team's inspiration growing to infinity.

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This fearsome predator avoided extinction and roamed our field... They kept it simple and refined from start to finish. This team's arms are short, but their Industrial Design reaches far!
This flock of young'ens are quickly learning to soar. They've shown grit, heart and will keep rising above the tide. The Judge's Award for finding their wisdom early goes to EagleTron.

The name is Agents. Rookie Agents. With their creative gadgets and assets, they were suited for the occasion. This team is thick as thieves, and their agents accepted and executed the perfect season. They deciphered the game while making an impact in their community. We cannot wait to see the upcoming missions they accomplish.

Just sit right back and you'll hear a tale - a tale of a fateful team. Stranded at sea, they could have stayed marooned, but instead they built a better robot. No longer lost, this team has slayed its demons to win this award.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team isn't green when it comes to building a program and brining in new members. From closing down during Covid, to opening their build space to everyone, they're creating an environment that fosters inclusiveness. Like Steve Irwin, this team is all about sustainability.
When we speak about spirit, this team is a cut above the rest. They fostered kinship and advocacy through mentorship and multiple camps. If spirit was a food, they'd stab, stab, scoop it up!
This team will keep you awake at night yet is very chill. They can recognize a problem, focus on it and get it solved before you finish a coffee break. Yes!! They are excellent engineers.
Building knowledge for a fleet of robo-engineers... This team doesn't dumb it down and is a rising tide that raises many ships. It's a no brainer that SMART is the best choice for this award!

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: A rolling stone might not gather moss, but this team sure can gather algae and coral. They made sure that their operator could see the light... light emitting diodes that is. In a landside decision, their creativity was judged top notch.

With spines sharp and bright, a meticulous art, their quality build, playing a winning part. The team effectively explained their design and rationale, grounded in the principles of need, wants and scoring. They possess a thorough understanding of their robotics construction. From clean wiring to secure attachments, their robot didn't hedge on quality.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: From a dark galaxy, far, far away. This team was a force in controls innovation. They demonstrated exceptional discipline in design, assembly, and deployment, resulting in a higher degree of automation and alignment in robot functioning. They are jedis of innovation!

This team segmented their priorities, using the golden rule of simplicity and function, they portioned single button designs. Peeling back the layers of iteration, you find a sweet and seamless blend of creativity and programming, as this team sliced their problems into manageable solutions.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: Elegance, Sophistication. This team extends in many directions. With a decade of design experience, they are no stranger with keeping their brand alive, and incorporating ideas to the finished robot is not alien. When it comes to their image this team has an extra byte.

The FIRST impact award recognizes a team that has made significant efforts to inspire and empower their community. Our winning team has focused their efforts in this area by reaching out to underrepresented communities in STEM. Through strategic community events, they've created opportunities for local youth to find an outlet for science and technology, fostering an inclusive enviroment. Their focus on reaching those who are not often reached exemplifies the core values of FIRST. For these reasons, the FIRST Impact Award goes to RobCoBots.

This team peppered the judges with evidence of their teams impressive passion of spreading STEM in their community. They embraced their lessons learned and turned themselves into a "hot" commodity. Congratulations to our pink friends, team 2640, HOTBOTZ!

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: Rising from the deep with the tenacity of mighty marine mammals, this unstoppable crew has masterfully balanced form, function, and aesthetics in their design. Their well-rounded, all-purpose robot deftly pinpoints its position on the field while scoring algae and corals at every level. Prepare to be blown away by the one and only Team 9032, The RoboWhales!

They woke us up with their app from left field. This team let us all through their digital security to allow use of their thorough scouting data. Their sensory first aid kits and Sunday morning reports are impressive and appreciated. Congrats to team Firewall, 5607.

Small and stealthy, this team crept in through the underbrush. Even with few resources at hand, their heart for FIRST shows up like spots. Step back while they leap onto the scene! Congratulation to Team 10260, The Robojags

This team understood that to fly high, sometimes you need to go back to the drawing board and keep things simple. As a flock, they embraced teaching & training new members to ensure continued success in the years to come. Please join me in congratulating Team 9042, Soarin’

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team ventures through valleys and "over hills" to build their community and sustain their team. From their summer outreach to their accepting family culture this "wiry" team impressed the judges. Join me and congratulating team 7443 the Jag-Wires!

Proud and prepared -- this team exhibits enthusiastic support at all levels. They earn double + for their C theme. When it comes to team spirit, they take the cake...I mean cookies. Congratulations to Team 4816, The Gadget Girls!

Steam rises from this cool, caffeinated crew, fueling a polished engineering process from initial concept to final deployment. They meticulously refine and fortify their machine to handle both coral and algae intake, forging a practical yet elegant solution that champions safety at every step. Join us in applauding the innovative accomplishments of Iced Java, Team 6894!

It's no secret that Gracious Professionalism is a crucial part of FIRST. This team acted as diplomats -- scavenging strong connections between competing teams. Drop those disguises and come on down! Congratulations to Team 10077, The H.E.I.S.T.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: You could spot their strategy from a mile away—strong, smart, and seriously well-built. With rigging-style fastenings, fiberglass strength, and precision 3D-printed stops, they engineered every move with purpose. Let’s hear it for the team that turned bold ideas into big results—Mind Over Metal, Team 8205!

This team advanced a rich design with many features following the KISS principle (Keep It Simple, Students). The consistency and reliability of their machine was demonstrated on the field and through minimal repairs in the pits, making them as unique as their striped namesake. Congratulations to Team 900, The Zebracorns!

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: When grabbing a ride, you hope the ship captain has absolute control. From coral to algae to barge -- their integrated functionality was Prefect...I mean perfect. Grab your towel...and Don't Panic. Congratulations to Team 2059, The Hitchhikers

A crackle of electricity swirls around these ingenious enchanters who weave technology and teamwork into a flawless spell. They ignite, analyze, calibrate, and adapt their robot’s movement, ensuring it senses its environment and autonomously conquers tasks. Conjuring unstoppable success from the realm of robotics greatness, please join us in celebrating the Autonomous Award winners: The Wired Wizards, Team 4534!

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: These rock stars of the robot world often make the stars align. Their grey exterior doesn't hide the true gems inside their team. This team is both "igneous" and "ingenius". Congratulations to Team #8757, Geodebots.

When you're out at sea, navigating among the reefs and algae, you might be FEARFUL when you see this team coming. They don't play to stereotype, as their efforts in recruitment, building a FLEET of FLL and FTC, and making it possible for others to engage really inspires. From RECRUITMENT REEF to HOUSTON HARBOR, this team follows their MAP to success.
This team has inspired a FIERY culture of Engineering excellence. Their passion has generated STEAM across the community. They have FANNED THE FLAMES of technology globally.

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This team's robot requires attributes to be top-shelf for the end result to be FRUITFUL this season, including outstanding abilities to climb, and a fully custom elevator to handle the upper game pieces, all of which ride on a NICELY COLORED mix of 3D printed parts. This team is sure to bring a JUICY start to the day.

This team came in HOT when fixing their drive. They didn't just FLOAT along, they SCOUTED the currents steering all the teams toward the richest reefs of opportunity. Teamwork isn't just important, it's the ultimate CYBERSECURITY key to success.

Honoring a team that has truly BLOWN US AWAY, from their first GUST of inspiration to the GALE FORCE determination that carried them to success, this team has proved that they are a FORCE OF NATURE. They have strategically worked to train and engage their members from across their county. They didn't just go wherever the WIND took them, they charted a course to build a robot and team that exemplifies the best of FIRST.

This CITY team is rebuilding their HOUSE as a welcoming place where all are welcome to join to build and dine. Their rebuilding journey has been successful as they have TAGGED new members and supported both their FIRST and academic journeys. This team is truly ONE PACK!

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team SOARED around the world to virtually engage INDIA. Facing financial constraints, they learned to HAWK, reuse and upcycle. They are a beacon of GREEN LIGHT for FIRST.

This team DOVE DEEP into the true spirit of a Robotics FIRST event. They were SLOW AND STEADY throughout the event in cheering, chanting, and stepping, for not only their team, but for all others competing. Their spirit and fun TUTU FLAIR are a reminder that, like a healthy reef, it's not just about the competition, but supporting one another through their team spirit.

This team's thoughtful design, driven by careful analysis, clearly allows for impressive adaptability and performance. When faced with a challenge, this team doesn't just troubleshoot, they execute SWIFT PIT STOPS to swap their elevator or other components. Their professional approach to being a QUICK-CHANGE ARTIST makes them the fastest team on the EAST SIDE.

We'd like to give a THUMBS UP to this team who reminded us that a simple gesture of encouragement can ripple outwards like waves in the ocean. Their helpful actions uplifted teams to PEAK performance. On their GALACTIC FIRST NC journey, they have shown the importance of respect and kindness 42 times.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team hoped their creativity would SERVE them well in this year's game. Their innovative approach gave them a unique perspective of the field, and allowed them to rise above the challenge. Proving that ingenuity runs deep in their BLUE DNA, this team is ready to set sail.

This robot was designed from the ground up to be robust, maintainable, and easily serviceable. From exceptional bumper design to exquisite wiring and an innovative access port, this robot really SOARS above the rest. You might even say they have TRANSFORMED over the years into a PRIME example of designing a quality robot.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: Mastering control of the sea to save the reef, This HYBRID ANIMAL team charted a course for excellence. With sensors, cameras, and LEDs guiding the way, they showed their true STRIPES and blew their own HORN.
Navigating a SEA of software challenges, this team relied on every sensor, but SONAR, for precise execution and unwavering accuracy. These CARY CETACEANS have truly mastered autonomous operations.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team is colorful and resilient, and are NATURALLY STRONG on and off the field. When their robot broke, they found an alternative, and made things at home like POM-POMS. They ROCK-IT like a RAM!

This team isn’t just building robots—they’re ramping up inclusion, proving that engineering isn’t just about innovation—it’s about impact. Their genuine ability to show RESPECT has them leading the way, and showing the world what it truly means to work together! This team’s game-changing driver station ramp will be the new official FIRST ramp at Worlds in 2025 and roll out to all North American regionals by 2026.
Solving all kinds of problems and inspiring little minds. This team extends its reach beyond the fence and farm. No rogue syntax here – only Engineering Inspiration. Go, baby go.

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: The waves were high and the reefs were tall. These intrepid travelers persevered through it all. This robot is sleek and shines like the North Star The blue and green voyageur works fantastic and looks great doing it all.

This team caught the judge’s eye with their ability to seize the day. They lobby legislators, guide teams globally, and take their robotic passions to the skies. They may not swim in the ocean, but they make the Red River Rage.

When lost in the forest, this team is there to lend a helping hand. They are carving out a new path for robotics in their region with a safe environment for all. Their positive spirit is larger than Paul Bunyan.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team sails ahead with innovation, resilience, and a deep commitment to sustainability With a strong tide of organization and a flair for bling, they’ve anchored their space and charted a course for success This crew continues to navigate new waters, growing, adapting and inspiring with their creativity and dedication.
When teams are tired and dragging This crew brings the TECH and starts dancing And doesn’t take NO for an answer.
After developing many ships. This team built a seaworthy vessel. Their design process kept these cats dry while piloting towards the Excellence in Engineering Award.
This team heard the noise and answered the Buzz. They provided a part, fostering a Full tide of Sportsmanship. They will wear this Metal of honor on their Jacket.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: With hidden belts and a powerful spring. Grabbing algae in one hand and coral in…. that same hand. When it comes to creativity, this team is a force to be reckoned with.

This team knew they needed to make changes to be successful in extracting the algae and delivering the coral The "system checks" that are in place help give this Robot a positive charge The black and grey clouds don’t limit the communication within this Robot’s new refined wiring strategy

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: Part of their approach is twisted. The controls are a step ahead of the rest Their robot moves like rolling thunder

To level 4 again and again this team places coral with speed and grace Up and down and round and round to get smooth consistency and accuracy With a color to match the reef we see beyond the visible spectrum

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: When you gaze across the reef, this team‘s brand stands out among the coral. Their image reigns over land and sea! Get ready to be enchanted by Te Fiti!

This team is transforming society, one initiative at a time. Engaging their local community through Girls who Code, Girl Scout Badges, and other FIRST programs, they know how to make an impact. Their reach goes far beyond building robots. Hosting dinners, sending holiday cards, and running various STEM programming, this team engages with people of all ages. This team builds people through Lego therapy, connections, engagement with legislatures, and opportunities, all through being a force for change.

Transforming culture to where young people dream of becoming science and technology leaders might be the vision of FIRST, but it is also the vision of this team. They focus on making FIRST accessible to their community by making all their programs free for members. This team created robotics curriculum for incoming freshman, donated robotics equipment to schools overseas, and partnered with a local organization to support environmental sustainability with STEM. Like being at the core of an atom, they are a force for change, a catalyst for growth, and a beacon of inclusivity.

FIRST's mission is to give young people the skills, confidence, and resilience to build a better world, something that this team believes at their core. Running FIRST teams at every level, this team has created a sustainable pipeline to get young people involved in FIRST. Even outside of their FIRST initiatives, everything comes back to FIRST and it's mission. Hopping from island to island, inspiring, collaborating, educating, fostering community, and discovering as they go.

Inspiring the next generation to pursue STEAM is at the heart of everything this team does. Their partnerships across FIRST programs have helped grow FIRST both at home and across New England, ensuring all students for years to come will have the ability to join teams across the district. Their oars in the water guide them to inspiration.

This team is volunteering here today, mentoring FLL and FTC teams, and assisting teams near and far. You can find them anywhere from sharing presentations at FRC events to hosting summer camps, and even at the statehouse advocating for FIRST. With out of this world outreach and creating new programs at their school, they boosted the availability of STEM programs by more than 5000%.

records.awardName: District Championship Rookie All Star Award
records.script: This rookie team rose from the ashes of a defunct program, demonstrating resilience and a deep commitment to spreading the mission of FIRST. Right out of the gate, they have a solid business plan with detailed budgets, team organization goals, and a complete SWOT analysis to set them up for the future. They are grateful for the support of so many teams who helped make this first season a success and are already working to give back generously. With support from over 20 local businesses, they’ve built strong relationships, even creating a shopping list for those who prefer donating components over simply contributing funds. This team and their wonderful pepperoni-hating mascot know there is never a reason to scrap something that can be reimagined.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - Ballard Division presented by Altair
records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This team has established streamlined manufacturing pathways, able to iterate in less than a day. They have a simple and elegant robot, enabled by their strategic use of COTS parts. With their exceptional ability to cleanup the reef, they'll have no shortage of straws to enjoy some BAJA Blast.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - Ballard Division presented by Altair
records.script: This team's robot turned the judges heads. Its clean lines and purple highlights made waves. When they take the field, they turn the "Tide".

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - Ballard Division presented by Altair
records.script: This team fully demonstrates the most important values of FIRST despite experiencing recent turnover in both members and mentors. From promoting STEAM in underrepresented communities through STEAM nights and ensuring funding through a pi day fundraiser; they act as a role model for all FIRST teams. This team takes pride in ensuring that people from all walks of life know they deserve a spot at the table. With their wide ranging involvement in the local community you could say this team is quite, "Poly"-morphous.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - Ballard Division presented by Altair
records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: With their ability to budget, teach, and recruit, it's no question this team is sustainable. They're so passionate about Earth's sustainability that thhey plan to shake up FIRST with pool noodle substitutes. They may be blue, but they're also soooo green.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - Ballard Division presented by Altair
records.script: This team has shown an incredible dedication to showcasing their enthusiasm. With their recent rebrand that represents their community, this pod has shifted their team culture to be one that is welcoming to all students. With their themed sub-team names and their evident dedication to promoting team morale, this team is on a "lobstah" roll.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - Ballard Division presented by Altair
records.script: A strong engineering process is critical to consistent success. There was one team that demonstrated to the judges they understand this. With detailed requirements, test plans, and witnessed tests this team explained to the judges their detailed system engineering process. This team "shall" use the force to create an excellent robot.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - Ballard Division presented by Altair
records.script: This team comes to the rescue when other teams are struggling. Whether it’s to help with load in or impact preparation. This team is driving its way to a varsity letter.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - Ballard Division presented by Altair
records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This creative team's robot has personality. While many teams designed passive intakes, only one chose a passive coral placement. This choice helped hop to the top of the competition.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - Ballard Division presented by Altair
records.script: This team is so dedicated to quality that they were cleaning sensors while being judged. Every aspect of this robot reflects an unwavering attention to detail; it is pristine like a pearl. The judges score this team 10, 10, 10 in quality.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - Ballard Division presented by Altair
records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: This team really spun their gears when designing their control system. From industrial camera to a custom tablet interface, this team has their priorities straight. Their optimal scoring strategy gave them a real "advantage" to win this award.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - Ballard Division presented by Altair
records.script: At the start of the match, this team separates themselves from the herd. This team handles rough seas, like it does climbing mountainous terrain. From auto to tele-op to end game, their consistent scoring really get their opponents' goat.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - Ballard Division presented by Altair
records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: Most teams have a robust robot design process. Many teams have a custom drive team uniform. This team uses “Brown Paper” to make their Phoenix soar.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - Sosik Division presented by GE Aerospace
records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: The elegance of this team’s robot was second to none. It can handle coral or algae with ease. Their chic robot is black and their team color is green.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - Sosik Division presented by GE Aerospace
records.script: The Judge’s designate this as the Empowerment Award- This team empowers their students and their city by providing STEM opportunities to those who wouldn't otherwise have access and a monster amount of outreach to help their community. Despite the Chaos, this team can still be a home.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - Sosik Division presented by GE Aerospace
records.script: This team is considered a role model for other young teams. Despite losing access to their shop for several weeks during this build season, this team took the opportunity to continue to spread the mission of FIRST. Their seventy-six outreach events, even during adversity, mark this as a star on the rise.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - Sosik Division presented by GE Aerospace
records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: Big things can start small. They can even start at small schools and with the help of small businesses. We know this team is on the right trail to success, and we expect to see huge accomplishments from them in the future, while they help provide a positive outlet for other FRC teams to work and practice.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - Sosik Division presented by GE Aerospace
records.script: Their bubbly spirit was apparent to the judges. Students exude this through their custom designs and logos. They spread their humor and fund through buttons and cheers, so you can afford to let the smile fool you.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - Sosik Division presented by GE Aerospace
records.script: This team started with a precise problem statement. They iterated through numerous revisions, meticulously created assembly drawings, and numbered every part. They may have the red line, but they are pink to the core.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - Sosik Division presented by GE Aerospace
records.script: Uniting the shore is this team's specialty. Despite their small size, they make a huge effort to support fellow teams with space, materials, and knowledge. Not to Hammer in their gracious professionalism too much, but...

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - Sosik Division presented by GE Aerospace
records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team's robot slips and slides over the waves. They never break down under the mayhem of play. Their arm is driven by a set of sturdy chains. This Teal Eel is a winner in so many ways.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - Sosik Division presented by GE Aerospace
records.script: The quality of this team BLUE the judges away! Any six motors and any six bolts are guaranteed to be the same. An easily maintainable robot is the key to their success. Any subsystem can be removed in six bolts or less. This team must've made a deal with the devil for such a well-designed robot.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - Sosik Division presented by GE Aerospace
records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: This team is on the prowl. They innovated in their methods to intake coral from the ground and open sourced it to many. Their robot may not say “robot”, “Shirt” or “hoodie” but it does say Bobcat.

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - Sosik Division presented by GE Aerospace
records.script: The judges were really impressed with the "fetching" math this team put into their autonomous features. This team was shooting for the barge and restoring corals without touching a single control! Let's hear it for Lagoto!

records.eventName: New England FIRST District Championship - Sosik Division presented by GE Aerospace
records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team’s appearance is consistent between the pit, the bot, and the team’s entire design. They are able to explain the colors and history of the theme. This new look is vibrant and recognizable and can be seen across the field of play.

records.eventName: FIRST Championship - FIRST Robotics Competition - Newton Division
records.script: This team has more than DOUBLE their community average in achieving higher education goals. They reach students in CREATIVE ways, whether while waiting in line or looking for a NEW BOOK. The team members are WARRIORS for their community to have opportunities to study robotics and engineering. Congratulations, Team 1880 Warriors of East Harlem New York, New York, USA

records.eventName: FIRST Championship - FIRST Robotics Competition - Newton Division
records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This team approached their build season with a new philosophy. Their LED indicators added a shine on their sleek, black design from pre-checks to endgame. This robot might just give you WHIPLASH. Congratulations, Team 148 Robowranglers Greenville, Texas, USA

records.eventName: FIRST Championship - FIRST Robotics Competition - Newton Division
records.script: The is the Judges Award for “FIRST in Display” This is what the judges had to say. This team is recognized for their creative outreach. Their engineering CAD and manufacturing prowess deserves to be in a MUSEUM. Their RED WINGS will SOAR their patent replica to promote FIRST in a PRESIDENTIAL library. Congratulations, Team 1807 Redbird Robotics Allentown, New Jersey, USA

records.eventName: FIRST Championship - FIRST Robotics Competition - Newton Division
records.script: This team practices inclusion in every decision, putting people FIRST before robots. From ESCAPE ROOMS to AI powered sponsor relationships, they BUILD A CASEFILE to fulfill their SECRET MISSION with FIRST. This team has now broken their cover by HEISTING this award. The Rookie All-Star Award is presented to: Team 10077 The H.E.I.S.T. Huntersville, North Carolina, USA

records.eventName: FIRST Championship - FIRST Robotics Competition - Newton Division
records.script: This team has risen from the DEPTHS of the OCEAN. The loss of their workspace and the distance separating them has not stopped them building a robot and impacting their community. These PIRATES keep SAILING at full speed, refusing to abandon SHIP. Congratulations, Team 9787 Fathom Robotics Baker, Florida, USA

records.eventName: FIRST Championship - FIRST Robotics Competition - Newton Division
records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team won’t be SCARED into the DANGER ZONE. With a whirlwind of outreach that CALMS the HUMAN MIND and expands STEAM OPPORTUNITY. They are revolutionizing a legislative branch of sustainability. Congratulations, Team 1710 The Ravonics Revolution Olathe, Kansas, USA

records.eventName: FIRST Championship - FIRST Robotics Competition - Newton Division
records.script: This team’s amazing spirit is shown through their student-designed branding, incredible support for one another and undeniable passion for spreading STEM and FIRST. These COOL CATS uplift the spirit of everyone that meets them. These incredible artists PUT THE A IN STEAM. Congratulations, Team 108 SigmaC@t Robotics Fort Lauderdale, Florida, USA

records.eventName: FIRST Championship - FIRST Robotics Competition - Newton Division
records.script: This teams’ commitment to excellence powers their pursuit of perfection, one breakthrough at a time. With RELENTLESS INNOVATION and UNYIELDING STRENGTH, these young engineers push the boundaries of what’s possible. With a focus on CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT, they re-designed their robot into VOLUME 2. Congratulations, Team 10428 KAIZEN JAIPUR, Rajasthan, India

records.eventName: FIRST Championship - FIRST Robotics Competition - Newton Division
records.script: This team has a HUNGER to advance STEM in their region and beyond. Approaching GOAT status, they FUEL each others’ DREAMS and KICK-START innovation with their allies. FEEL THE MUSIC and FEAST on their accomplishments, STAT! Congratulations, Team 2635 Lake Monsters Lake Oswego, Oregon, USA

records.eventName: FIRST Championship - FIRST Robotics Competition - Newton Division
records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team has been driving the competition with a design that is next-level and efficient to a T. They took their innovation to different heights with a DIFFERENTIAL GEARBOX using bevel gears. They’re not just building to win - THEY”RE ENGINEERING WITH MAD INTENTION Congratulations, Team 1323 MadTown Robotics Madera, California, USA

records.eventName: FIRST Championship - FIRST Robotics Competition - Newton Division
records.script: Regular maintenance enabled this cleanly wired and well-built robot to withstand the rigors of competition. With its subsystem ARMOR, no damage was sustained in countless matches. Greasing and polishing were just a few tasks that kept matches from getting CHAOTIC. Congratulations, Team 5468 Chaos Theory Bend, Oregon, USA

records.eventName: FIRST Championship - FIRST Robotics Competition - Newton Division
records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: This GREEN team’s vertical and horizontal intake was highly effective. They used trigonometric calculations to build custom algorithms, OPTIMIZING their ability. It’s no surprise that this team POPPED OUT as a leader. Congratulations, Team 2910 Jack in the Bot Mill Creek, Washington, USA

records.eventName: FIRST Championship - FIRST Robotics Competition - Newton Division
records.script: They racked up HIGH scores with custom pathing software and cameras galore. Their NEURAL NETWORK detected coral’s position AND its’ orientation. This team is KILT-Y of being awesome. Congratulations, Team 4499 The Highlanders Fort Collins, Colorado, USA

records.eventName: FIRST Championship - FIRST Robotics Competition - Newton Division
records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: The judges immediately recognized the attractive and distinctive image that this team portrays. They SOW, GROW and HARVEST STEM in their area. They incorporate FIRST core values especially fun because nothing runs like a TRACTOR. Congratulations, Team 3655 Tractor Technicians Mason, Michigan, USA

This team supports and mentors FLL and FTC teams. They also work with Scouts and Unified teams. This team has recognized the need to improve their outreach and are working towards improvements. Their journey has been going from island to island as they continue to develop life changing robotics programs. Some teams like to have fun but this team likes to have One Clean Day of Fun. Congratulations 1071, Team MAX!

This team aims to “spark” up STEM education in their state. When not hosting FLL summer camps, you can find them donating meals and toys to their community. They are reviving the state legislature by working with their state representatives to amend STEM education inequality in New Hampshire. Congratulations to 2342 team Phoenix!

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This Industrial Design Award celebrates a team whose motto this year was “keep it simple”. From the calculated angle of their elevator to the use of LiDAR sensors, they developed a standardized approach in their design for manufacturing. With mechanisms removable in six bolts or less, this robot is *devilishly* elegant, efficient, and practical. Congratulations to the Industrial Design Award winner, Team 6324, The Blue Devils.

This team was an exciting blast from the past. Their use of reliable existing technology that they had access to in the basement where they meet. It isn’t madness to recognize that setting a goal and surpassing it earns recognition. The judges award goes to 6895 Mechanical Madness with their resourceful wooden robot!

This team understands not only the power of FIRST but used it as a colossus inspiration to rebuild with a behemoth effort. After they lost all but four members, mentors and funding, they pulled together to recruit new members and recoup funding to complete this year. With their development of a sustainable plan to last them for seasons to come, this team is a role model for all teams who are forced to rebuild.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: Ensuring that a team exists not only this year but also in ten, is an incredible undertaking. By forging fantastic relationships with school districts and their local newspaper, they used grants to build a pipeline from FLL to FTC to sustain their team for years to come. With this team’s undeniable documentation, monthly outreach events, and reusing fire truck metal to build, 1729 Team Inconceivable will be competing for years to come!

This team has extraordinary spirit through its enthusiasm as they ride the waves of spirit and outreach in both competitions and their community. With the E in team referring to "everyone" this team is full of spirit. Congratulations to team 8724 Team Mayhem.

As a strong contender in all aspects of this game, this team’s engineering skills are seen not only in the reflection of their moon pool but also when controlling their robot using autopilot. This team has harpooned the engineering inspiration award. Congratulations, Team 138, Entropy

This team always steps up to help others, you may find them in anyone's Pitt. This team is sharing parts code and CAD files, not just regionally but worldwide. Gracious professionalism is WINDING up their spirit of FIRST. The gracious professionalism award goes to team 3467 Windam Windup.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This Creativity Award winner stands out against the crowd. Their lead screw launched coral without getting dizzy in the process, with a telescoping arm that sets their sights on the stars. With unique pivot placement and a creative take on the game, the Creativity Award goes to Team 4761, The Robockets.

(Sing to “Eye of the Tiger”) Rising up, back on the workmanship. Did their welds, and their wiring. Went the distance, to demonstrate their quality. The team and their will to win… Congratulations to team 2877 LigerBots on winning the quality award!

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: This team used analysis to guarantee the safe driving of their robot. Their curve ensured that the robot would not tip at any speed. Innovation in control was the overdrive of their design. The Innovation in Control Award goes to Team 8410 Overdrive!

This team’s robot seemed to have a mind of its own. Their autonomous capabilities helped propel them forward in both autonomous and tele-op modes, placing coral and algae with a flash of rainbow. In the end, this gave them an advantage like no other. Congratulations to team 6328, Mechanical Advantage!

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: You can spot this team from any distance, you can always find these COMPANIONS. Their design is not a lie and as easy as cake. With a branding standard to ensure they never get lost There is no reason to get confused with the COMPLEXITY Of their design. The imagery award goes to Ov3R1y KOMpl3x Team 8708.

They are more than a team; they are a community. They have an impact not only on their students, they had an impact on their community and region. As a team, they have inspired many others to soar and they sparked a fire for STEM and beyond.

Recruiting across many towns and schools resulted in initiatives spanning state lines and multiplying Chief Delphi threads. Getting involved with legislature, rebranding, and getting software into the Kit of Parts, puts this team at an Advantage.

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This team is polished to hide in the deep blue see with black and green. Interesting design with a drop in the hopper, side mounted elevator and motor upside down, they focused on mechanical rigor and preventing mechanical failure.
Zipping around and scoring sideways, this team cannot be missed. You don’t need a speaker to hear them. In their community, and in the pits, you won’t need massive googly eyes to see them.
This team focused on art, tech, community, and simplicity. Thinking on their feet, they and Martin can get through any marsh.

There was no Crescendo for this team last year when a Tornado came through their whole membership. Sometimes disaster recovery looks like a solo veteran student working late nights, in a school shirt, to revive an entire team.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team excels at both team and environmental sustainability. Hosting Experiential Ed sessions for FIRST Lego League, and banning plastic water bottles, keep the team growing and their environment, including their pond, alive. This allows Gone Fishin’ to continue building robots.

“Cohesive team spirit” is important to this team, so they rebranded. Now, everything is going swimmingly as they grew their small team and share their power by teaching 4th graders. The incredible energy and upbeat attitude of the Power Sharks is palpable.

This team took prototyping seriously. They had a blast on and off the field using lessons from an intense preseason learning project and designing to adjust for stray game pieces on the field. This team professionally wound up their goals for this competition.

Gracious Professionalism award goes to a team we have all seen support the teams around them. From helping to drive for another team to helping children drive. They keep everyone engaged with their powerful movie knights.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team has consistently harpooned their way through the competition and dazzled the judges with their lights. They’ve certainly channeled chaos into their creativity.

This team built a solid machine that can weather stormy seas. They have high standards for their robot on the field, choosing to focus on their most reliable mechanisms and using strong 3D printed parts to bring their team to plastic success. This robot will not be needing an eye patch.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: This team decided to make exploring of the depths of the seas easy on their driver. When they decide to go for the climb, they really “lock in”. They have done an amazing job at taking gravity into their control, and have taken their robot’s stability into Overdrive.
This team’s robot has demonstrated a clear ability to reliably score coral in autonomous mode with a robust, reliable approach. Even under pressure, this team’s robot has shown its stripes.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team’s tiered marketing strategy integrates sponsors into their robot, banners, merchandise, and pit area. Their team number is even the hex code for their signature color. For their bold and cohesive visuals, make sure to check out this team at the Hopkington State Fair.

There are many established teams who struggle to spread STEM and the values of FIRST to their community. The judges felt this team best addressed those challenges with tenacity and focus. From volunteering at the mall judging FLL, to establishing and funding local teams, and even meeting with local legislature - this team is ENGINEERING change. While this team is relatively newer, they have overcome multiple challenges and in a short time created an immense and unQUESTIONABLE impact on the community.

Fliers, commercials, back to school night to recruit, oh my. They even teach seniors how to make their drones fly. From their local gingerbread-gineering to their global computer training they distribute in Brazil. Can you guess WHO? I bet you will!

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This team designed their robot around core features to compete. They engineered a deep hang in the center of the robot and a flexible manipulator that traversed quickly to load and shoot coral. The judges want to recognize this team for designing their robot to support their key strengths.
This team mentors several FRC teams. They go the extra mile to promote STEM to at-risk youth. The strength of this team is strong like IRON. The judges award for GOING THE EXTRA MILE goes to…

They may be the new fish on the reef, but they did great on the field. With their googly eyes looking forward, their actions exceed expectations. This team is staying TWO STEPS AHEAD on their way to Lehigh
