Setting the example by being EMPOWERED LEADERS, the Judges recognized that this team ENTHUSIASTICALLY looked for ways to build TRUST and a STRONGER connection within their community. Their method of generating STEM awareness for this year’s game and the FIRST community really caught the Judges’ eyes. This team has taken their own time FORGING keepsakes for us all to enjoy, for just a simple donation to their local food bank. The Judges would like to present the “Feed It Forward” award.

records.awardName: District Championship Rookie All Star Award
records.script: Starting an FRC team from scratch is never easy, but with determination, resourcefulness, and a shared passion for robotics, anything is possible. This rookie team built on their FTC experience, trained with mock Kickoffs, competed at off-season events, and formed strong mentorship bonds before their first official match. Their proactive spirit and summer-long preparation made it A CLEAR SHOT—they weren’t just ready for FRC, they were ready to be Rookie All-Stars.

This small team has a healthy drive and commitment to FIRST. INGREDIENTS like a creative approach to their maker spaces, partnerships, and funding, make a TASTY blend. They have their finger on the PULSE of their community and elevate others to do the same.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: Many teams inspire young students to join FIRST and get involved in STEM, but this team really excels in showcasing their success in recruiting through statistics. This team’s well-documented and data-driven recruiting and retention efforts ensure a steady stream of dedicated incoming team members. Their diverse funding strategy ensures they can support their growing team. It has definitely BEEN DETERMINED that this team is built to last.

The dedication of this large student group to FIRST’s core values washes over their community in an overwhelming flood of support and inspiration. Finding their team is not hard. They seem to have a knack for being where they are needed at events in their school, and in their neighborhoods, as well as on the screen. The judges would like to describe this team in far more detail, but we are unable. It may be CONFIDENTIAL.

This HOT team doesn’t just wing it – they plan, test, and iterate. They engineered with sharp attention to details. Every wire routed, every part prototyped. They learn from others, share with the world, and organize their designs with care. These BIRDS aren’t just flying. They are soaring with EGGcellence in Engineering.

This team may be small, but they are a mighty force when it comes to uplifting others, both during and outside of competition season. From supporting multiple FLL teams, to providing a practice space to nearly 20 FRC teams, this team spreads FIRST Values across the REALMS. Instead of a gold star this team has a GOLD CROWN.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team can never LEGO of a great idea. The need to remove algae never SLIPPED their minds, nor did it BREAK their determination to clear the reef. They drew on multiple sources to CLUTCH their final design and bring it full CIRCUIT.

This team built their robot with serviceability in mind, ensuring every component was designed to be easily replaceable. Their attention to detail resulted in a robot that is as beautiful as it is durable, keeping its TENDONS well protected. With a collision avoidance system that prevents self-damage, don’t call the MEDICS.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: With sensors sharp as teeth, this team has an arm that can SPIN circles around their competition. This monster from the deep is a master of controlling both Algae and Coral. Bringing vision into the virtual world, they are well on their QUEST for victory.

With multiple eyes scanning the sea, this ship hardly needs a captain to navigate the reef with uncanny speed. With one press of a button, their coral pops onto the reef with a PHANTOM-like grace. No ifs, ands, or buoys about it, with a reliable 4-coral payload, this team has auto scoring in the BOX!

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.teamName: SWARM - South and West Albany Robotics Maniacs
records.script: This team dove into the reef going above and beyond embracing the water game. Mimicking the BIOLUMINESCENT creatures of the deep, this robot’s bright lights help to rally their allies to their side. BEE aware of their stingers, there are some JELLYFISH about to float on down.

This team worked ferociously to represent FIRST's core values and mission this season. They expanded their team, both in size and and influence. This team excels in hands on outreach, above and beyond showing off their robot. They created curriculum and made focused and successful efforts to recruit females into FIRST. Like their mascots, a pack of wolverines makes a big impact.

This team is giving the competition a wake up call. Despite working with a limited budget, they proved their innovation isn't about resources, it's about determination. Through inclusive STEM workshop and mentorship, they've inspired future engineers across all ages, showing tat anyone can build, create, and dream. Their impact reaches far beyond competition, proving that true engineering comes from resilience and passion for sharing knowledge.

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This team created a robot that efficiently and precisely handles all tasks on the field. Their design process emphasized both sub-systems and the whole robot, prioritizing elegance and simplicity. The team manufactured their own parts, carefully considering details to ensure durability during the game challenges. The robot windmills coral and algae simultaneously with reliable success.
This team was well-rounded in both technical and team attributes. They fit squarely into the judges hearts and exceeded expectations exponentially. Oh yeah..., we wanna recognize this team!

This team truly understands what FIRST is trying to accomplish and that "technical stuff" is fun, challenging, and offers a future! Their consistent efforts on and off the field truly make this team worthy of recognition. These rookies have proven their sovereignty on the field.

These cool cats lept into action when needed. Their robot rose from the ashes to make it to their second competition. They didn't start the fire, but they stopped the burnin' cause of what they're learnin'!

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team takes their environment seriously. After all, it is where they fly. They work towards growth and look to the future for both their team and the earth. A bird can't hunt prey without a thriving environment.

This team demonstrates spirit through the team's attitude, appearance, and originality. Spirit is not just a part of the team, it's what they do! Their energy is truly "ram-pacious", and they’ve charged through every challenge with an unyielding spirit

This team was able to describe their engineering process from start to finish. Their engineering solutions were designed to accomplish specific mission objectives. They took advantage of their design as they clawed through the competition. This team moved around the field as if in boiling water!

This small but mighty team exemplified the spirit of Gracious professionalism through teamwork, inclusivity and agility . They have an innovative approach to recruiting members and have the formula for retaining them by creating an environment where everyone can grow and learn together. Not only are they reaping success, but they are also sharing their positive energy and strategy with others.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team’s creative thinking has truly set them apart with an intake design that’s as innovative as it is effective. Their windmill-inspired mechanism effortlessly picks up both coral and algae game-pieces, showcasing their engineering prowess. Clearly, they’ve got the MOJO to make waves under the sea!
This robot can survive any STRIKE on the field. They have brought their robot's durability and quality to new heights. This team used precision when focused on reliability and robustness.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: This team took control of their success as if the field was in the palm of their hand. They hammered home their innovative navigation, with built in redundancy and honed in sensor vision to find their way through the shallow reef. Bruce hit the nail on the head and expertly piloted his way to a unique and reliable solution.

When kicking off a match, this team separates itself from the herd. Consistent and reliable performance set the stage for handling rough terrain. Their autonomous functions in auto, teleop, and end-game led to consistent scoring throughout the match.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team glides it's way to success. Their iconic and unique style pays tribute to their founding mentors. This team has maneuvered itself through contested waters.

records.eventName: FSC District North Charleston Event presented by South Carolina Department of Education
records.script: Today we celebrate a group who has truly made an impact through their creative outreach and initiatives. They have brought energy and inspiration, “igniting” positive change all around us. Let’s give a round of applause to the creators of STEAM town.

records.eventName: FSC District North Charleston Event presented by South Carolina Department of Education
records.script: With steady determination and frontier spirit, this teams leads by riding tall in the saddle. Bringing STEM into their community, they galloped ahead of the competition on their favorite steed – “Seahorse.”

records.eventName: FSC District North Charleston Event presented by South Carolina Department of Education
records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This team glided through the competition with style and strength, leaving a trail as smooth as a shadow gliding beneath the waves. Their creation, the graceful and battle worthy “Manta Ray,” helping to take them to the next level.

records.eventName: FSC District North Charleston Event presented by South Carolina Department of Education
records.script: This “Sparking Change” award recognizes a team that fosters positive change through innovative efforts. This particular team has stood out for their perseverance and ability to nurture growth, both in the soil and in the community.

records.eventName: FSC District North Charleston Event presented by South Carolina Department of Education
records.script: This team is demonstrating the FIRST Core Values with such an overwhelming positive vibes. Even though this team only started building last month they have risen to the challenge. “Hey Chat, they are all-stars, it’s NO CAP.”

records.eventName: FSC District North Charleston Event presented by South Carolina Department of Education
records.script: This team has faced the challenges of new beginnings with determination. Despite their youth and recent challenges, this team has demonstrated an unwavering commitment to the FIRST Core Values, embracing Gracious Professionalism and Coopertition, blazing the way both on and off the field.

records.eventName: FSC District North Charleston Event presented by South Carolina Department of Education
records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: The judges found this team to be unique with clear plans to both individually and collectively raise money and have a well-thought-out budget to meet their immediate needs and future goals while accounting for the unexpected. This team has taken an event out of their control like a powerful storm and rebounded it with a long-term plan to recruit and train new members all while keeping their parents, sponsors, and local community engaged in the team’s overall sustainability.

records.eventName: FSC District North Charleston Event presented by South Carolina Department of Education
records.script: This team is not only a partnership but a family. Prioritizing the FIRST Core Values of teamwork and fun. This team is a “Prime” example of team spirit, elevating the level of fun that all of the spectators have had throughout the competition.

records.eventName: FSC District North Charleston Event presented by South Carolina Department of Education
records.script: This award honors a team whose engineering brilliance has set the standard in this competition. With a spirit that burns bright, their approach to engineering reflects both ingenuity and rigor. The judges were particularly struck by their hyper-iterative design cycles, meticulously documented to a professional level which elevated their work above the rest.

records.eventName: FSC District North Charleston Event presented by South Carolina Department of Education
records.script: Helping other teams both on and off the field, this team works together with the precision of a well-oiled machine. Showing determination as strong as steel and a spirit that never fades, no matter how “blue” the challenge, demonstrating their commitment to the FIRST Core Values in everything they do.

records.eventName: FSC District North Charleston Event presented by South Carolina Department of Education
records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: One crew set sail with a wild idea, envisioning a boat hook and suction cup in their arsenal, and unleashed a beast that no pirate would ever dare challenge. Their treasure of the deep? The mighty “Kraken!”

records.eventName: FSC District North Charleston Event presented by South Carolina Department of Education
records.script: This team built a steel-framed powerhouse holding nothing back. Their rugged and reliable solution consistently hit the mark using crosshairs to lock onto their targets. When it comes to this competition, they are definitely not the “underdogs” in anyone’s book.

records.eventName: FSC District North Charleston Event presented by South Carolina Department of Education
records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: As this team drove onto the field, their unique control strategy stood out from the competition. They could watch and drive virtually from the point of view of the robot, immersing themselves in the game, and helping them succeed throughout the competition.

records.eventName: FSC District North Charleston Event presented by South Carolina Department of Education
records.script: The judges were impressed by the remarkable intelligence and adaptability visible from this team’s autonomous mode and computer vision use. There is a saying that “well written software is indistinguishable from Magic, which was effectively demonstrated with this robot’s ability to retrieve coral from the ground with fail-safes and retry logic. When the waves retreat, it shows nothing but excellence as this team’s “Tsunami” enters the field.

records.eventName: FSC District North Charleston Event presented by South Carolina Department of Education
records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team’s image is fueling our desire to strive higher with an innovative enthusiasm. They are truly a one stop station for making FIRST look good.

records.eventName: FIRST South Carolina State Championship presented by Magna
records.script: The judges were impressed by the team's polished presentation and how easily they fielded questions, demonstrating a deep understanding of their team and its impact. Their outreach efforts, from developing new teams to bringing STEM into classrooms and presenting at workshops, showed they weren't just building robots, they were building a future for others. To sustain the momentum of their outreach efforts, the team’s student mentorship isn't just showing the ropes, it is a shining example of how to share the complexities of team leadership and pass the torch. When the clouds cleared, one name stood at the center of the storm…..Marvin, oh wait….

records.eventName: FIRST South Carolina State Championship presented by Magna
records.script: Winning the Engineering Inspiration Award is a testament to this team's dedication to making STEM accessible and exciting for everyone. With teamwork as their engine, they made every challenge fun and every success a shared celebration. They engaged students through creative outreach, opened their work area to support other teams, and kept the energy high as the train to STEAM Town rolled on.

records.eventName: FIRST South Carolina State Championship presented by Magna
records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This award honors a team whose robot embodies the art of industrial design through elegance, efficiency, and practicality. With a spirit as bold as a cowboy crossing the frontier, this squad has corralled our praise with their lean creation. The design’s robust, focused mechanics and human assisted flow show they’ve roped in only what matters—no extra baggage on this wagon!

records.eventName: FIRST South Carolina State Championship presented by Magna
records.script: This “Try, Try Again” award is being given to a team who took the trial and error method to heart. Whether it was working on their coding or bumpers, they continued to strive for improvement, empowering their young all-girls team. We look forward to seeing what this team can accomplish when they truly hit their “prime.”

records.eventName: FIRST South Carolina State Championship presented by Magna
records.awardName: District Championship Rookie All Star Award
records.script: This team is thrilled to be involved with FIRST and experiencing something new. They have embraced becoming a part of the FIRST SC family, realizing early on that it was okay to ask for help and learn from other teams. While they of course would like to win, that would just be a bonus on top of all the fun they're having, and we can't wait to see where they'll go next.

records.eventName: FIRST South Carolina State Championship presented by Magna
records.script: This team lit up when sharing their plan for success with the judges. With committees to divide robot and non-robot tasks, they are held together with far more than duct tape. We look forward to seeing them “saddle up” for many years to come.

records.eventName: FIRST South Carolina State Championship presented by Magna
records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team focuses on creating an inclusive environment, particularly for students with special needs, while also fostering community engagement and environmental sustainability. Their name “Bob Blue,” inspired by their jackets, adds a unique and fun element to their team identify.

records.eventName: FIRST South Carolina State Championship presented by Magna
records.script: This team has demonstrated team spirit at events, camaraderie, and unity in their accomplishments. They have been making their way to the top while being inclusive and inviting all area students to join. With a little “magic”, this team has experienced success and finished in the green.

records.eventName: FIRST South Carolina State Championship presented by Magna
records.script: This team has embodied the spirit of continuous improvement throughout the competition. Their clever and resourceful approach made sure to keep the target in their crosshairs and all their steely resolve took them from underdogs to “Undercogs.”

records.eventName: FIRST South Carolina State Championship presented by Magna
records.script: This “jewel” of a team has been recognized by teams and volunteers alike for always being polite and helpful. Standing out like a pearl, this team lead by demonstration, showing what it means to be gracious and professional. You could say that they are our “knights in shining armor.”

records.eventName: FIRST South Carolina State Championship presented by Magna
records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This award honors a team that splashes robotics with a wave of creative genius. Moving with the playful cunning of an octopus, this crew has reeled in our awe with their unique flair. Their carbon fiber retractable arm that rolls up and vacuum for coral collection showcase an “ink-redible” stroke of imagination in action.

records.eventName: FIRST South Carolina State Championship presented by Magna
records.script: This team rose to new heights with a high-quality, well-built machine. They light the way for others with a unique loading system to ensure alignment with the reef and their workmanship was “nothing but net.” The robots themselves may not have heart, but this team left us thinking “Oooh, Barracuda!”

records.eventName: FIRST South Carolina State Championship presented by Magna
records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: This team built their robot with a controls design that is both fascinating and innovative. With a professional standalone visualization system to robustly aid drivers for a sustainable controls framework, this team was truly “built by anglers, for anglers.”

records.eventName: FIRST South Carolina State Championship presented by Magna
records.script: This innovative team is redefining how robots are operated on the field with their robot requiring only minimal intervention. A true marvel of artificial intelligence and engineering that allows it to navigate the complex setup with precision and adapt to its surroundings seamlessly without error, no one would believe that this robot was built in a garage!

records.eventName: FIRST South Carolina State Championship presented by Magna
records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: To say that this team has their head out in space is not a bad thing. From their well-lit pit to the sleekness of their robot, you will need to be familiar with the constellations to be partnered up with them. The judges thought they were really “out of this world.”

This team has been a storm of energy and dedication, working tirelessly to expand the reach of FIRST and bringing STEM into their community. Whether they’ve been mentoring other teams, hosting outreach events, or generating a whirlwind of interest in STEM, their impact has been nothing short of incredible. This team has proven that it’s not just about building a robot — it’s about building a force that can change the future of robotics and technology not just in their community but in South Carolina and beyond. From their outreach efforts to their engagement with local schools, they’ve been creating a hurricane of inspiration. Their work is a true testament to the power of collaboration and leadership in the FIRST community. Their outreach has caused a surge of excitement for STEM, bringing new opportunities and possibilities to the next generation of innovators. So, without further delay, let’s ride the wave of excitement and congratulate this incredible team!

This team has been on fire this season, demonstrating not just technical skill, but also a deep commitment to spreading the excitement of engineering and STEM in their community. Their outreach, workshops, and mentorship have drawn others in, sparking a lasting interest in robotics and engineering. Through their efforts, they’ve energized the community and inspired the next generation of engineers. Like a well-built magnet, they’ve created a spark that continues to burn brightly, igniting a passion for STEM in everyone they touch.

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This team’s wave-inspired design blends both strength and elegance and their robot is so well put together that it’s starting to replicate itself. While they aren’t “assaulting” the competition, they’re certainly the “top of the reef”.

This team takes a high energy approach in panicked situations. With their soft wheels and clearance rollers as their black and white solution, they solved low clearance problems with a “manic” design when engineering their robot.

This team demonstrated a true eagerness for everything FIRST has to offer. With plans to continue growing their team and encouraging others to join them in their zest for learning about robotics, they have a wonderfully blazing attitude.

This team wowed the judges with their stellar teamwork and innovation. Their robot launches into challenges with precision like a comet streaking across the sky. With coding brilliance and unstoppable energy, they’re leaping toward a future filled with limitless possibilities.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team shows commitment to their community through outreach and education. Like a wild herd thundering across the plains, their robot’s design stampedes over the competition with durability and efficiency. With their unstoppable energy, they’re focused driving the future of their area toward sustainability and innovation.

Even though this team is new to the scene, they really shone out amongst the competition in both the stands and pits. Electrifying the night with their enthusiasm and bringing a bright wave of energy to the competition, their actions definitely “completed the circuit”.

This team used the perfect fusion of mechanical ingenuity and persistence to “Dominate” the field. Like a master navigator at sea locked onto challenges with the precision of crosshairs, they’re certainly not an “underdog.”

With their great teamwork and communication, this team will always have the “wind in their sails.” They not only impressed the judges but made a noticeable impact on the experience of other teams this weekend, proving that even pirates can be kind.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This robot made waves with its bold design and dynamic performance. With their custom 3D printed gears, they crashed through the competition with both style and creativity. Their ingenuity blended ocean power with magic creating a “spellbinding” robotic masterpiece.

This team’s utilization of precise cuts in their design and integrated camera system ensured that their robot was sleek, well-designed, and was able to stand up through the competition. Helping to elevate them over the competition by stacking corals seamlessly, this team was able to stay as cool as metal, “steeling” the show!

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: This team exhibited meticulous control of their machine. They had a special trick up their sleeve – a vision system with a VR connection. This along with their focus on mental health ensured that they always rolled out of the garage centered and clear headed.

Similar to ocean currents, this team’s autonomous systems were formed with precision and innovation. With oceanic grace, they set a new course for robotic excellence. Much like a goddess rising from the sea, their robot “Thalassa” “bedeviled” the competition.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team masterfully blended their team’s theme throughout the aesthetics of their robot and costumes, making sure there was no mistaking who they are. It’s “not easy being green” but this team definitely “leafs” the way.

Weaving together their stories, community, and interests, they leave the world a better place. What others have started with seeds of interest, they have pollenated and sowed. The ocean abounds with fish, but this team PARTS the waves and has created an ecosystem of abundance for FIRST.

The devil may be in the details, but the prizes are in the process. Powering through their designs, documentation, and STEM demos, this team promotes the values of FIRST. A little bit of horsepower always seems to inspire.

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This team had "one" the judges' hearts, and they had "zero" reservations in giving them this award. Their unique design "bolted" together to form an elegant solution to the reef problem. They are coded to win industrial design.

When looking for a competitive edge, this team turned to data analytics. By developing their own scouting software and app, these polka dots are powering up the brackets. These young women truly are FIRST ladies!
Being a new team is like swimming upstream. By distributing the workload across the colony and seeking assistance when needed, the dam won't hold them back.

Whether coming, going, or rising up - their number is the same. They graciously accept help and guidance, and they are well-prepared to take on bigger challenges, challengers, and obstacles still yet to come. Be on the lookout for this rising star.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: A raptor knows not to over-consume its prey, as that is not long-lasting. But this team practices sustainability for their team, STEM, their state, and our world. This flock of nerds will be flying for a very long time with their team sustainability.
This team shows up and shows out with monstrous enthusiasm. The chants and cheers left all the other teams green with envy. No matter how hard you try, you can't ignore the Ogres.

When confronted with stormy engineering challenges, this team's metal-strong designs stood up against all. They engineered their vessel with precision, creativity, and technical execution to forge solutions that sailed beyond the competition. They're in command of engineering excellence.

A town in California, a town in Maine, and ghost towns in Texas and Nebraska. Everywhere you go, the name pops up from their reputation, skill, and kindness. They exude an impressive example of far-reaching gracious professionalism from the hills.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team's high energy sent them to an unusual place to find a solution for this year's challenge. This team found a solution in a parent's garage. From their coral turret to their sparkling funnel, this team's creativity really shines.
Don't tell anybody this well-designed, rugged robot caused chaos with the other robots. It's no secret that this team blows away the competition. Their quality doesn't have a half life.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: Believe it or not, this team was able to press all the right buttons to control the field. Just so you know, their robot did the griddy on the grid.

Precision, consistency, and flawless execution—sounds like the signature of a certain tribe we all know. Their ability to reliably score 3 out of 3 corals during autonomous time set them apart from the competition.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: Like the sun rising over the ocean or a rocket racing to the sky, this team and their robot are impossible to miss. Gazing up to the reef, the flamingo places the coral and algae in stunning pink!

There is a rising force like a shining star, combining the spirit of student leadership, inclusivity, and innovation. This force has succeeded in guiding young people into the world of STEM through barrier-breaking educational projects, a global knowledge network with multilingual resources, and inspiring social initiatives. The historical grandeur and imperial legacy reflected in their name show that this team is truly a symbol of inspiration and change.

This team has made it their mission to use the power of STEM to reach disadvantaged regions starting from their own province. Despite their young age, with great determination and courage, they established an organization to inspire young people like themselves. This team not only impressed the judges with their work but also served as a source of inspiration to those around them. Carrying the fresh breeze of lavender gardens, they brought not only innovative ideas to the competition but also a vision that inspires their community.

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: Beginning with a 2D sketch, they come up with a final product which impressed people with its functionality, form and quality. They shared their well defined design and development process with FIRST community. 360 degrees rotating arm also spins our heads.

Although this team was not the first FIRST team in their city, it has become one of the most influential. Despite being a relatively young team, they have managed to touch as many people as possible by growing their projects and increasing their impact each year. With their energy and passion, they earned the judges' appreciation. The pajamas they wear emphasize not only their long working hours, but also their spirit of giving back, their commitment to FIRST values and their passion for bringing fun together.

This team has created a fun team spirit that embraces FIRST values. Despite being a rookie team, they have managed to win the admiration of the judges and their community with their attitude and projects, and they embrace their values with nine arms.

This team won the appreciation of the judges by not giving up despite the great challenges they faced in their first year and continuing on their way with perseverance and determination. They made it their mission to spread FIRST values and STEAM culture through various competitions they organized to develop their community. Inspiring their community with the power of unity and solidarity, this team has managed to become a true role model. We sincerely congratulate this team for becoming the heroes of a hero city.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: In addition to being a growing and strong team, this team stands out with its gender equality among its members, attracted the attention of the judges with the importance they attach to sponsor continuity, team structuring and the development of rookie members. Their projects to raise environmental awareness, from the solar energy-themed hackathon to the EcoGuard catamaran, reveal their vision for a sustainable future.

This team did not just build a robot; they built a spirit, a dream, a journey. With their excitement, determination, and endless energy, they carried the FIRST spirit in their hearts both on and off the field. So much so that they didn’t just shine as a team—they even blended in harmony with the colors of our judges. And now, like the scientist whose name they proudly carry, this rookie team rises with perseverance, collaboration, and the power of achieving together to write their own story.

Through their superb engineering effort, this team managed to persist stability on heights that can rival basketball players. With their documentation and engineering presentation, this team enlightened our path using their golden torch.

This team shines not only with their own achievements but also with the support they provide to others. With their gracious professionalism, they collaborated with many teams throughout the season and embodied the core values of FIRST in the best way. This team showed us the true meaning of solidarity by growing through sharing, learning by teaching, and bringing a tool board to the Pit area for teams in need to use.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team didn’t just limit engineering to functionality; they added a touch of magic and caught everyone’s attention with their mechanism that unfolds like a magic wand. By combining creativity and functionality, they designed an unconventional collapsible system, showcasing the fun side of engineering. This team—ironically, despite their name—designed a system full of gears and mechanisms, dazzling everyone on the field.

Real quality rises from the perfect combination of details. The winner of this award not only focused on fine details but also embeded their hard work into their robot, leaving their mark on every part. Just like the sharp focus of a tiger stalking its prey, this team worked with great care, leaving no detail unchecked.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: They always aimed high with their stable gripper and agile movements. They achieved this with agile and flexible controls. They managed to fire their rockets even in difficult conditions.

In a field of fierce competition, one robot moved with great precision thanks to its sensors and data handling. With no driver at the controls, this predator navigated its environment with razor-sharp vision and claws, executing each task with effortless agility. This wildcat didn’t just follow a path—it led the chase.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: It is almost impossible not to notice this team! They lit up the atmosphere like the sun with their team colors and won the hearts of the jury with their spirit of unity, showing everyone the power of achieving together. Even though their mascot was a fox, they worked like ants. Dazzling with their orange jumpsuits and impressive stage presence, this team fully deserves the Imagery Award!

They successfully managed to stay sustainable and enriching while developing brilliant and pioneering international projects. They not only express their impact in numbers, but also show the joy of being a team with the sparks in their eyes. They carry this light to their new members and everyone they encounter. They continue to develop, upgrade, and spread their unique projects with the ecosystem they created. They successfully contributed to the visibility of women in STEM by maintaining equal contributions from their female members, and the girls they have reached out. They supported practical education with the kits they created. Likewise, they gained a considerable amount of international members on UDEMY education platform. We think that their team name is an emphasis to the importance they put on sustainability.

The work of this team not only transcended its own boundaries, but also maximized FIRST's criteria for expanding and spreading the STEAM mission with clear and measurable qualities. They were able to elevate and communicate this process in the best possible way while creating an impactful and sustainable impact in different regions. They continue to uplift, inspire and elevate their communities with their shining achievements.

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This team has combined engineering and aesthetics in the best way. Coming from far away, they made an innovative touch by skillfully incorporating a ski board. Inspired by the spirit of the Patron Saints, they proved their engineering excellence by winning the Industrial Design Award.
This team stood out as a strong candidate for many awards. They won the judges' hearts by involving new students in their teams, constantly improving their projects, and spreading the spirit of FIRST

This team created a strong team spirit by attracting their vocational high school friends like a magnet from a FIRST team that had closed down. With this collaboration, they demonstrated the power of solidarity and partnership while spreading FIRST values. The way they shared their success with different friends and the dedication they showed despite being a rookie team impressed not only their community but also the judges.

This team demonstrated great determination by rebuilding themselves in just 4 months. They strongly reflected their team spirit and advanced rapidly. Like the female warrior in their logo, they were determined and resilient.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team created many projects over the years and kept them alive, becoming a perfect example for everyone in sustainability. This team worked tremendously hard to spread the FIRST spirit and values, almost as if adding a new dimension to sustainability.

By basing team spirit on equality, they prioritized intra-team democracy through the assembly system. This team has completed numerous social responsibility projects with all its volunteers to promote equality, enhance FIRST belonging, and ensure high performance among its members. By introducing other schools to FIRST, they have expanded this value unity and STEM to more students.

This team combined their expertise in software with unique and practical mechanical functions to create a robot that performs effectively on the field while fulfilling all its functions. If there were an award for the team with the most cameras, they would undoubtedly win that. This team attracted with their innovative deployer designs attention with their slogan "more than a robot”.

During the preparation and competition, they were recognized for their sportsmanship both on and off the field. They showcased a great example of GP with the many FRC and FTC teams they established. With the association they quickly formed, they promoted cooperation and support.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team demonstrated how to solve an engineering problem in a practical, low-cost, and easy-to-implement way with the solution they found in their intake. Instead of a complex, expensive solution, they presented a simple, inexpensive one that still works. This is creative engineering…

This team has engineered a robot that stands out for its exceptional design and quality. Their groundbreaking intake mechanism operates sustainably effective on the field, while their sturdy construction guarantees reliability in challenging situations. Drawing inspiration from the wisdom and strength of their mascot, Kirin, they have crafted a truly remarkable creation.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: This team is one of the few that performs ground picking operations. They have combined the most innovative control systems with electronic, mechanics and software. With the cameras and sensors on their robots, they scanned the field like a ghost and overtook their competitors with the agility of a shark.

This time, they did not soar through the skies but glided through the depths of the ocean like a fish. Their robot successfully completed its tasks with stability and precision, even without a driver. With its environmental awareness and sharp accuracy in reaching its target, they have rightfully earned this award.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: The mightiest dragon of the seas and FIRST. By capturing eyes and attention in every pit area with their PURPLE color, energizing the stands with their lively and cheerful team members, and bringing the DIVE concept to their booths in the best way possible, they have successfully impressed the judges and all participants.

This team impressed the judges with their inspiring body of work, especially on this year's theme "Dive". They conquered the vast landscape of FIRST with educational programs, events, competitions, tech solutions to real life problems while comitting to sustainability, inclusivity, equality and data-proven accountability. As a force of nature and unity, it's only fitting that this creation of Poseidon is galloping it's way into this season's Impact Award.

This award goes to a team that works not just for a competition, but for future generations. They turn STEM into a passion, inspiring their community and making technology more accessible. Creating a sustainable and measurable impact, this team is a true pioneer in building a brighter future. “While they temporarily put a dot on their journey” they continue to overcome challenges and aim for the stars!

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: The harmony of engineering and design, an innovation-driven approach, and the fusion of aesthetics with functionality... This award winner has optimized their robots using generative design and topology optimization. They created a modular system that speeds up maintenance and assembly. Their durable yet flexible conical mounts set them apart. Inspired by snowboards, they introduced a unique coral deployment system. And of course, we know them for their chocolates, their Alps, and their watches...

This team has successfully reflected their style to all the jury members through their harmony, discipline, passion, and technological approach. This time, they truly deserve this special award, as if it was drawn for them from the tarot cards! Congratulations, Adroit Adroids!

Despite being in their first year, this team has demonstrated a leadership vision and a diverse range of community activities, showing great potential to become a promising FRC team in the future. As an independent team, they have proven their versatility not only in science, technology, engineering, and the arts but also in literature, philosophy, and sports by coming together across multiple disciplines. Let’s celebrate the birth of the wolves, taking the FRC spirit one step further!

We are talking about a team that has risen again, stronger than ever, and is shining brightly! This team has not only viewed the competition as a goal, but has made it their mission to create a butterfly effect for societal impact, contributing to the vision of FIRST. Their success is shaped not only by their technical skills, but also by the strong bonds formed among team members. Today, we honor the team that represents this determination and passion. And now, the team that will be remembered not only for their achievements but also for their inspiring journey:

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: his team has made sustainability not just a goal but a way of life. They encourage recycling with their point-based waste management system while adding an aesthetic touch to the environment through art created from waste materials. The team boosts public awareness through educational outreach activities and secures both today and tomorrow by establishing their own association. Just like their axolotl mascot, constantly regenerating and growing, they continue to evolve and inspire.

When we visited them, we saw a vibrant and energetic team that filled the atmosphere with excitement. Almost every member actively contributes, collaborating with a total of 240 local and international schools. With their outstanding work, they have truly made an impression, creating a corporate identity through the processes and documents they have prepared! Congratulations, Flare Team! With your high energy and dedication, you have done an amazing job!

This team, striving for excellence in engineering, stood out with their meticulous process management, detailed documentation, and disciplined approach. Prioritizing safety, they ensured flawless execution on the field. Their mastery of perception techniques enhanced the functionality of their design, blending deep-rooted engineering traditions with innovation, spices, and philosophy. Committed to continuous improvement, they have become an inspiration through their professional approach to the design process.

This team has truly embodied the FIRST core values of teamwork and cooperation, which makes them well deserving of this award. Even before meeting them, we had already heard their name from many other teams. Despite having limited resources, their generosity and positive attitude knew no boundaries—in fact, it crossed continents! May their motto inspire us all as we say, “Less is More!”

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: Every morning we open our eyes under the yellow light of the sun and dream. This team from far away lands fascinates us with their dreams. They discover innovative solutions through data analysis. Every movement of their robots fascinates us thanks to advanced algorithms and complex engineering. They made one robot which is the most creative !

This team placed quality at the heart of their entire journey, from the very first sketches to the final turn of the last screw. Cables, mechanical parts, motors, and sensors seemed to dance in harmony across the robot. That magnificent hand, gripping the wrench tightly, held not only the nuts but also the algae and corals on the field with perfect determination.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: This team didn’t just start with an idea by proclaiming “Innovation is practice!” – they tested it on the field every day and perfected it. With their unique enhanced coral collection design, they successfully gathered the 3.5 corals. By integrating a LED light strategy into their control skills, they signed their team communication in golden letters. And now, the team that carries that legendary golden brilliance into the field… Golden Horn!

Their auto-acceleration and high hits in the first 15 seconds were enough to capture our hearts. But they were not satisfied with this and managed to make a difference throughout the competition with their speed and agility. You can recognize them by their robots that move like black lightning on the field…congratulations wildcats, Istanbul

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This Team has taken their rightful place in FRC history by attracting attention not only with their technical performance but also with their visual design. They have managed to create an innovative design by putting their efforts and passion into practice. They have inspired us with their innovative presentation style. This award is a symbol of their dedication and creativity. We congratulate our team on this achievement. We wish them to continue with the same determination in their future projects.

This team is bringing science and technology to young people who lack access to STEM through workshops, mentorship programs, and school collaborations. They are making an impact by initiating the FTC teams in foreign countries, expanding FIRST to rural areas, and developing STEM programs for individuals with disabilities. Through all these efforts, this team has pioneered the formation of 7 FTC teams, inspired over 320 schools, and reached more than 4,350 young minds—spreading the light of engineering from India to the world.

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: The recipient of this award has taken functionality to the next level with modular structures and durable mechanical designs. They stood out with their precise weight distribution, multi-stage elevator mechanism, and efficient power transmission through a well-engineered gearbox design. Their robot, named Adroit, demonstrated exceptional performance on the field with its compact and effective component placement.

"FIRST values and Gracious Professionalism means making a difference not only in the field, but in every aspect of life! Being committed to ethical values ​​means improving the world through collaboration! Being creative and persistent to solve problems! This team deserves special recognition for their unique efforts, effective solutions, the lives they touched, and the magical presentations they put on in the field."

This team may be experienced in the FIRST family, but they are “Rookies” in FRC! They developed gamified applications to make STEM more engaging, fought against educational inequality, and created their own mini-games in game design workshops. But they didn’t stop there! Not only did they participate in the “Save the Sea” competition, but they also took action to save our planet. As a new yet ambitious team, they are ready to make their mark in the FRC arena!

"Our team, established this year, embraced the FIRST spirit despite the various difficulties that come with being new. They began teaching engineering by starting with pliers and an Allen wrench, and provided tool usage and battery training to nearby middle schools. Taking inspiration from the intelligence, resilience, and agility of the Anatolian Wolves for their team principles, our team impressed the judges with their sincere presentations"

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: "This team has not only seen FIRST’s sustainability principle as a goal but has also placed it at the core of its projects, aiming to improve both the environment and human life. They have used artificial intelligence not just as a tool but as a solution partner. This year’s award-winning team are the parrots who have embraced the principle of growing FIRST by sharing the achievements they have gained through the unity of wisdom and intelligence"

"This team, with all their motivation and enthusiasm, showcased their team spirit and managed to impress the judges. Their spirit spread beyond their temple like ripples in the water. Coming together hand in hand under the wings of the eagle, we celebrate this incredible team."

Shaped by a deep design approach and elevated by meticulous documentation processes, this team has set a new standard in engineering while creating a positive wave in our competition with their sustainable and impactful project. We congratulate this new yet professional team for their excellence-driven work and the remarkable difference they have made.

The team that won this award turned every challenge into an opportunity with strong collaborations from all over our country. With their positive approach and solution-oriented attitude, they overcame all the obstacles they faced and inspired us. With their Gracious Professionalism, they made a difference that affected not only their work but also everyone they connected with from the heart. They are our yellow flowers that 'touch our hearts

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team gained an advantage on the field with its innovative and unique perspective. They made a difference with their practical and creative solutions in the climbing task. They showed us that creativity is not about doing what has always been done, but about leading the way with new approaches.

The true strength of a robot lies not only in its speed or capabilities but in the quality of every component that makes it. Some robots stand out not just for their performance but for their spirit; they endure challenges with both resilience and elegance. Just like the legendary name it carries, Bumblebee is strong, reliable, and built with excellence. With its team’s outstanding engineering and meticulous craftsmanship, Bumblebee has claimed the top spot in the ‘Quality’ category.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: The auto acceleration and pinpoint precision they demonstrated in the first 15 seconds immediately captured the audience’s attention. Yet, that initial display was merely a glimpse of their true potential. By harmonizing machine functionality with human ingenuity and strategy, they delivered practical and effective solutions to the competition’s challenges. Their performance on the field was as agile, graceful, and striking as a cat…

This team has demonstrated exceptional precision and adaptability in autonomous mode, executing complex tasks with seamless efficiency. Their innovative approach to sensor integration and real-time decision-making sets a new standard in autonomous performance. Just like the tides they navigate, Their robot moves with unwavering control and purpose, conquering every challenge in their path

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: "You simply can’t miss this team—in the pit, the stands, or on the field, they stand out everywhere! With their bold orange and black stripes, they brought energy to the event, showcased their team spirit at every step, and won the hearts of the judges by proving the power of teamwork. Their mascot may be an orange cat, but don’t be fooled—this team isn’t just about looking cute! With their creativity, they’ve turned the field into a work of art. Their striking color coordination, consistency, and impressive presence make them truly shine. This team has earned the Imagery Award to the fullest!"

Building a pipeline from FLL to FTC to FRC is how this family was built. Cooperation between siblings serves as a source of support and friendship. Offering technical guidance has brought worldwide attention to their wiki. Judges love the "Legacy you leave behind" and it shows on your sister teams.

Inspiring elementary and middle schoolers is the heart and foundation of this team. Students battled for a course, to ignite students to inspire the love of STEM and FIRST. These cats clawed their way above obstacles so their community could battle in the air.

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This team prioritized simplicity and straightforwardness. Keeping the design simple makes them all the rage!

This team kept popping up in our deliberations, with their bright spirit, bold colors, and a chant that we just couldn’t get out of our heads. From mentoring not one, but two other FRC teams, to building assistive tech that makes a real-world impact, they’ve built a pipeline of passion and purpose—while proudly maintaining a 50% female team. They’ve truly embraced what it means to be a FIRST team… and we appreciate that!
This team has showed that it can be a competitor for years to come. This rookie team has showcased community, leadership, and vision. Taking home the rookie all-star is Team 10340 ITCAN Girls.

This incredible team has shattered barriers and made a lasting impact on their friends across the globe. When it comes to star-studded potential, one name shines bright. With their innovative outreach and captivating personality, they truly stand out.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team operates as a cohesive unit. They consistently attract NEO members with flashes of orange and purple building the team's success for years to come.
A full-body uniform is their disguise but not to their demise. This team showed gracious professionalism by cheering on the other teams! Imagine blue camo in the woods hunting for their win!

Instead of bringing the robot to the field, this team brings the field to the robot to get a competitive bump. They generated structural elements so organic they looked like they were grown on an artificial FARM. This team had the most excellent engineering OVER ALLs
This team includes members from backgrounds others might consider wild. Their positive attitude sparked on and off the field. A rookie-filled team is a gamble, but they played their cards right.

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team has proven they are no longer in robotics 101, when after their first compeition they had to pivot to a new robot. This team has proven that under creative difficulty to succeed...IT Can.
Their talons are far-reaching to allow scoring. The robot soars across the field with ease. An enthusiastic human player led to the quality of this robot.

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: This team PLAIN-LY has control of thier bot. They use one joystick, eight buttons, and lights of truth. They have ironed out their innovative controls.

When the lights turn green, this team’s autonomous game is as fierce and focused as their black-and-white mascot—no panda-monium here, just precision. With a robot that consistently delivered high scores—averaging over 30 points every match- they proved their code was as sharp as their strategy. These red-and-black-clad mercenaries sent Trident into battle with unstoppable accuracy.

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: We were all ears to hear about this team's community outreach and kids programs that support core values. They hopped on the bandwagon and show incredible cohesiveness with their robot and team imagery. NoBUNNY can deny that team 4063, TrikzR4Kids, has worked hard to show how amazing they are.

Making an impact in your community can be challenging when your team is in a rebuilding year. In addition to making sure students are learning and building a competitive robot, doing outreach, hosting events, and helping an international team that needs hand, creating an Impact Award submission can seem like one too many things to take on. This year's winner could have just skipped the extra work and spent their time shooting the t-shirt cannon at the football games, but they rose to the occasion and showed the judges that they know how to make an impact. Give it up for Team 8019- Patriot Engineering

This team took the field and led the charge to winning. Their force was felt in the pits as they looked to help others in need. They were unstoppable in scoring and their performance met their expectations. Give it up for Team 6369- Mercenary Robotics

records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: For those who turn "what if" into "why didn't we think of this sooner" This award honors designs that are smart, sleek, and just the right amount ove over engineered Congratulations to Team 3847- Spectrum

Swinging into action, this is a team who likes to have fun, but who can get down to business when needed. They have experienced significant growth and reinventions over the past couple of years, persevering over challenges to build a highly effective robot. The judges were continually impressed by their team unity and determination to improve. The judge's award goes to Team 457- The Grease Monkeys

Embarking on their inaugural journey in FIRST this year, these remarkable rookies have SOARED beyond the constraints of a limited budget and robot building experience, propelled by unwavering enthusiasm, perseverance, and resourcefulness worthy of a Silicon Valley start-up founder. They used every material out there including poly carb, wood, duct table, aluminum and even found a way to reuse a seatbelt! Please join us in celebrating the remarkable achievements and boundless potential of the fearless innovators as they start their FRC legacy. This year’s Rookie All Start award goes to the team from Bulverde Texas, Team 10518 Aluminum Falcons.

With an unwavering passion for robotics and a commitment to giving back, this rebel group has quickly made their mark. Their leadership in the community and their dedication to inspiring the next generation of engineers have set them apart as true role models. Your journey has just begun, and the future is looking brighter than ever. Keep reaching for the stars—Rogue-Rangers, the world is watching! Congratulations to FRC Team 8573, the Rogue-Rangers LEGACY, for their well-deserved recognition.

records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team proves that success is deeply rooted in utilizing each student’s strength. This team reaches out to friends, families, gearheads, and non-techies alike to garner support. This radical team has squarely developed effective methods to sustain and grow their organization exponentially. Congratulations to Team 7503 Radicubs

From the moment these WARRIORS entered the arena donning their distinctive white hats and shark fins, it was clear that they were united by a sense of pride and unity. From their well organized, decorated pit to their passionate support in the stands, it was clear that this team came ready for battle! Please join us in celebrating this year’s Team Spirit Award winners from Devine, Tx - Team 9311 Warhorse Robotics.

January 4, 2025 we all learned the rules of the game, this team sprung into action. Brainstorming and prioritizing solutions and prototyping resulting in a robust design incorporating the best mechanisms to accomplish their goals. Working their namsake into their design- the Excellence in Engineering Award goes to Team 6357- The Spring Konstant.

This team exemplifies Gracious Professionalism, always supporting fellow teams throughout the competition. Like paratroopers, they jump in at a moment’s notice, guiding others through challenges with skill and dedication. Beyond hands-on assistance, they go the extra mile by publishing manuals that empower teams to run impactful outreach events, ensuring their knowledge benefits the entire FIRST community”. Congratulations team 5414- Paradox

records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: With a deft flick for the wrist, this robot twirls the game pieces around. Its design stood out as different, thanks to differential drive. Placing pene and moving meatballs, the team creativity award goes to Team 9418 Pastabots

This award recognizes a team that embodies excellence in both design and execution, ensuring every detail of their robot is built to the highest standard. Like a puzzle waiting to be solved, their craftsmanship and innovation leave others in awe, with a machine as refined as it is mysterious. With their signature neon green shining through, this team proves that quality isn’t just a goal—it’s their identity. Congratulation Team 9080- ENIGMA

records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: This award recognizes a team that powers innovation with precision and control, ensuring every movement is as efficient as it is effective. Like true heroes of energy, they harness technology to drive their robot with seamless execution and smart design. With a name that sparks inspiration, this team proves that great control leads to even greater impact! Great Job Team 5892- Energy HEROs

This exceptional robot design and programming allowed this team to score 2-3 reefs at the top level. Thanks to precise control using Motion Magic for the elevator. Their dedication to innovation sets them apart and pushes the limits. This award goes to Team 5572- Rosbots

records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: Driving into the Reefscape, grabbing algae and coral, this team swam to success. They were recognizable by their sleek look and iconic theming. Featuring an exceptional visual aesthetic, the imagery award goes to Team 9034- The Space Dolphins

records.eventName: FIT District Space City @ Friendswood Event
records.script: Every Impact Award winner can tell a great story. But this team crafted theirs with rhyme and reason! Their story is one that covers not just their local impact, but a book that has gone global in 5 languages total! They are a team with a spring in their step!

records.eventName: FIT District Space City @ Friendswood Event
records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This team has refined their design through continuous improvements, creating a robot that is simple, efficient, and highly practical. Their ability to execute a clear vision while staying adaptable sets them apart. With a build as polished as its gold and white finish, they’ve mastered the art of industrial design.

records.eventName: FIT District Space City @ Friendswood Event
records.script: This team embodies growth, resilience, and inclusivity, continuously evolving as inspiring students. Their unwavering sense of duty and perseverance shines through in every challenge they embrace, reflecting the strong values that guide them.

records.eventName: FIT District Space City @ Friendswood Event
records.script: This team is truly student-led, and spend their time training, fundraising, and networking to expand the mission, even though they’re just getting started! They have the beginning of a symbiotic relationship between themselves and FIRST.

records.eventName: FIT District Space City @ Friendswood Event
records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team turns waste into opportunity, recycling batteries and metals to fund their activities. They shoot for the stars and keep on going down the highway they’re adopting! This team will keep shining for many years to come!

records.eventName: FIT District Space City @ Friendswood Event
records.script: In the stands, this team can't be missed with their high energy! They really crush it when it comes to spirit. The judges wanted to give them a poem, but nothing rhymes with orange.

records.eventName: FIT District Space City @ Friendswood Event
records.script: In an ocean reef on some far-off world, these intrepid explorers have gone from prototyping to creating via their excellent engineering processes. Just like the aurora borealis covers the sky, they created a magnetic Force that holds the line.

records.eventName: FIT District Space City @ Friendswood Event
records.script: Their spare parts are organized. Their training program promotes merit. Their tools are sharp. Do you need a hero?

records.eventName: FIT District Space City @ Friendswood Event
records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team proves that high-tech solutions can come from everyday materials. By repurposing common items for practical uses in their bot, they showcase ingenuity and resourcefulness, turning the ordinary into the extraordinary.

records.eventName: FIT District Space City @ Friendswood Event
records.script: This team has built a machine that not only performs well but looks knightly in shining armor. Their sleek polycarb panels protects their components and cable management fit for a royal court. Their dedication to excellence ensures that their machine is battle ready for every match!

records.eventName: FIT District Space City @ Friendswood Event
records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: On the field, it’s hard to avoid this bird of prey. Swooping through the dark with confident sense of surroundings, this machine tears through coral pieces like a raptor with a QUEST.

records.eventName: FIT District Space City @ Friendswood Event
records.script: This powerful team designed an autonomous system that is both efficient and high-scoring, seamlessly integrating multiple programming languages for consistent, reliable operation while maximizing speed. Their robot keeps the points flowing throughout the match, proving that automation can be both smart and powerful. They truly electrified the competition.

records.eventName: FIT District Space City @ Friendswood Event
records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: Their creative expression is a testament to the power of mentoring and empowering students, transforming innovative ideas into a visually captivating reality. This team redefines visual storytelling by merging the flair of a mad scientist with the whimsy of a charming puppet.

With focused and consistent efforts, this team helped over 50 FIRST teams mushroom in the last 3 years. With their community outreach events, they inspired several folks to join STEM and blossom their skills through their formative years. With specific focus on women in STEM, they managed to spread their roots and reach further into their community. With growing success, this team trapped into their school district, county, and state representatives spread awareness of FIRST.

This team empowers the next generation of innovators by inspiring STEM and engineering through grassroots outreach in underserved communities. They embody the FIRST Core Values by building sustainable programs that support a strong pipeline across all levels of FIRST—from LEGO League to the Robotics Competition. Operating in a region where STEM access is limited, their hands-on mentorship and training are driving real, lasting change. With grit, passion, and perseverance, they’ve gone rogue—redefining outreach and boldly expanding their impact. From their local neighborhoods to communities around the globe, this team is engineering a better future, one life at a time.

From creating, developing, and implementing TEKS curriculum into the district’s elementary schools to hosting extensive STEM summer camps, this team has put their signature colors on their community and district. They painted the Scouts black and orange by helping students earn their STEM badges. With advocating for FIRST and STEM on a national level, this army of orange has advanced FIRST initiatives far and wide.

This team’s efforts towards inclusivity and approachability have been on a local, national, and international level. They have created a product reaching the FIRST Community that is supplier agnostic, comes with 24/7 support, and is do-able for most teams. From FRC to FTC, this team ensures that Every “Bot-y” has the ability to compete.

records.awardName: District Championship Rookie All Star Award
records.script: The stars aligned for this team today! They soared above the rest with their problem-solving and determination. Their true passion for robotics and STEM is only topped by their hyperdrive to have fun, all while spreading FIRST and encouraging others to get involved. Making robotics approachable is this team's main mission.

records.awardName: District Championship Rookie All Star Award
records.script: This team ignited a curiosity by blending gameplay with meaningful hands on STEM learning to inspire lasting connections. They are united by a vision fueling imagination and inclusivity to transform existing models. They will chase infinite possibilities into their future to strengthen their ability to adapt, learn, and grow as future leaders in STEM.

records.eventName: FIRST In Texas District Championship - Mercury Division
records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: The design of this robust bot allows for L4 scoring on two planes, fore & aft. Red, Orange, Green, Blue, Indigo, and Violet - or is it purple? This purple coral eater runs the full spectrum of the Reefscape.

records.eventName: FIRST In Texas District Championship - Mercury Division
records.script: This team showcased remarkable ingenuity by using limited resources to build an impressive, low-cost robot that utilized over 90% of materials from a previous year’s model. This innovative approach not only resulted in a robot with a minimal carbon footprint, but also demonstrated a commitment to sustainability. Their outreach programs helped underprivileged communities, creating a positive impact on the community and showcasing dedication to social responsibility.

records.eventName: FIRST In Texas District Championship - Mercury Division
records.script: While lifting themselves, they’ve also lifted others—supporting local teams and serving their community with heart and humility. This team rebuilt from the ground up after facing the end of their original journey, showing true strength through renewal.

records.eventName: FIRST In Texas District Championship - Mercury Division
records.awardName: Team Sustainability Award sponsored by Dow
records.script: This team harnesses the grit of the West, and the power of innovation to ROPE IN responsible, future-focused practices. Their commitment to STEM outreach and intentionality in going green keep their legacy riding strong. From the Blackland Prairies to the world stage, this team leads the charge for a resource-wise future.

records.eventName: FIRST In Texas District Championship - Mercury Division
records.script: This team’s spirit makes others green with envy. They provide the skills needed for the future and spread knowledge of STEM to all segments of society. From little princesses, to safe spaces, to DIY manuals, this team makes sure every kid is pre-PEARED for success.

records.eventName: FIRST In Texas District Championship - Mercury Division
records.script: This team impressed the judges with a robust, fast-moving robot and clever design choices—including using an ID lanyard for tension. With their bright neon colors and unmistakable pink robot, this Girl Scout team brings both style and substance to the field.

records.eventName: FIRST In Texas District Championship - Mercury Division
records.script: This team’s positive attitude and commitment to uplifting the community make them a shining example of the FIRST Core Values. This international team supports others through initiatives like Project Translate, all while celebrating diversity and inclusion.

records.eventName: FIRST In Texas District Championship - Mercury Division
records.awardName: Creativity Award sponsored by Rockwell Automation
records.script: This team has demonstrated true creativity and bravery, taking risks to design a unique shooter robot that pushes the boundaries of innovation. With their fearless approach and the spirit of golden warriors, they’ve shown what it means to lead with bold ideas

records.eventName: FIRST In Texas District Championship - Mercury Division
records.script: This team’s attention to detail shows in every part of their build, from durable 3D-printed wire covers to smart redesigns that reduce damage and boost reliability. Like navigating a corn maze, they’ve found their way to victory with precision and innovation.

records.eventName: FIRST In Texas District Championship - Mercury Division
records.awardName: Innovation in Control Award sponsored by nVent
records.script: This team puts the SAUCE into their designs. With a game specific control interface, they SMOKE the competition. They SHRED the competition with their unique recipe for success.

records.eventName: FIRST In Texas District Championship - Mercury Division
records.script: This team created pandamonium on the field with their lightning fast cycle times. Like the tridents of old, they score three hits every time. For their impressive 99% accuracy, these MERCENARIES have taken this award for their own.

records.eventName: FIRST In Texas District Championship - Mercury Division
records.awardName: Imagery Award in honor of Jack Kamen
records.script: This team brings a flair and sparkling style. Their brand seamlessly integrates a mystique into their STEM endeavors. Little kids everywhere will celebrate this "PRINCESS Team.”

records.eventName: FIRST In Texas District Championship - Apollo Division
records.awardName: Industrial Design Award sponsored by General Motors
records.script: This brave team pushes high above the rest with a flash of black and hint of gold. This team is always aiming for improvement while being reliable on the field. Competing with valor is the way to win!

records.eventName: FIRST In Texas District Championship - Apollo Division
records.script: This team exemplifies a complete package, making significant strides in balancing creativity, robot performance, and the core beliefs of FIRST. With a team of dynamic leaders, they showcase innovative robot design, utilizing low-cost alternatives for auto alignment. They believe that the future is ours to engineer, embracing a cavalier spirit as they push the boundaries of innovation.

records.eventName: FIRST In Texas District Championship - Apollo Division
records.script: This team transitioned from their garage to their school and extended their reach by helping start FLL and FTC teams in Mexico. This team turns small sparks into big innovations and celebrates all the little things. They can see their stars rising!
